questions.stem:
— Do you think it is popular to ____ red envelopes (红包) on WeChat during festivals?
— Yes. But I prefer giving gifts to family members.
questions.reason: 考试最佳答案选 A。give out 强调把东西分发给多人，最贴近微信“发红包”的常规搭配。give away 强调免费赠送，在某些语境也可描述送红包，因此不能一概说 B 语法错误；本题按常规搭配取 A。give back 是归还，give up 是放弃。

enrichment.meaning: 分发；耗尽
enrichment.usage: 分发东西给多人；也可指燃料、体力耗尽。
enrichment.example: The teacher gave out the papers.
enrichment.translation: 老师分发了试卷。

enrichment.meaning: 赠送；泄露
enrichment.usage: 强调免费送出；也可指泄露秘密。
enrichment.example: She gave away her old books.
enrichment.translation: 她把旧书送给了别人。

enrichment.meaning: 归还
enrichment.usage: give sth back to sb；代词放中间，如 give it back。
enrichment.example: Please give the book back to me.
enrichment.translation: 请把书还给我。

enrichment.meaning: 放弃；戒除
enrichment.usage: give up doing；代词宾语放在中间，如 give it up。
enrichment.example: He gave up smoking last year.
enrichment.translation: 他去年戒烟了。

questions.examNote: 按分发红包的常规搭配选 A；B 在特定语境可用，详见解析。
questions.worked:
— Do you think it is popular to give out red envelopes (红包) on WeChat during festivals?
— Yes. But I prefer giving gifts to family members.

questions.stem:
— I think this skirt is very nice.
— I agree. But it's 500 yuan. I don't think I can ____
questions.reason: 500 yuan 提示这里讨论购买能力，afford 表示“买得起、负担得起”，常用 can/could afford sth 或 afford to do。find 是找到，put 是放，see 是看见，均不表示承担费用。原句口语中可省略已知宾语，完整表达为 I don't think I can afford it。

enrichment.meaning: 负担得起；有能力承担
enrichment.usage: 常与 can / could 连用，指时间或经济条件允许。
enrichment.example: I can't afford to buy a new car.
enrichment.translation: 我买不起一辆新车。
enrichment.contrast: afford 不仅表示支付能力，也可指承担后果或抽出时间。

enrichment.meaning: can 常表能力或许可，may 表许可或可能，must 表必须或肯定推测；can't 可表不能或否定推测，must not 是禁止。先根据上下文判断是在谈能力、规定还是推测，不能只按中文“能”机械选词。
enrichment.example: It may rain, so take an umbrella.
enrichment.translation: 可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

questions.worked:
— I think this skirt is very nice.
— I agree. But it's 500 yuan. I don't think I can afford

questions.stem: It's very cold outside. ____ your sweater before you go out.
questions.reason: 外面很冷，出门前应“穿上”毛衣，动作表达用 put on。turn on 打开电器；put up 张贴、搭建；turn off 关闭电器。注意 wear 表穿着的状态，与 put on 的动作意义不同。

enrichment.meaning: 穿上；上演
enrichment.usage: 穿戴时强调动作；也可指上演节目。
enrichment.example: Put on your coat before you go out.
enrichment.translation: 出门前穿上外套。

enrichment.meaning: 打开（电器、水等）
enrichment.usage: 指接通电源或开启开关，与 turn off 相对。
enrichment.example: Please turn on the light.
enrichment.translation: 请开灯。

enrichment.meaning: 张贴；搭建；举起
enrichment.usage: 根据宾语判断：put up a notice/a tent/your hand。
enrichment.example: They put up a tent by the lake.
enrichment.translation: 他们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

enrichment.meaning: 关闭（电器、水等）
enrichment.usage: 关闭开关；不是“关闭工厂”的常规表达。
enrichment.example: Turn off the TV before you leave.
enrichment.translation: 离开前关掉电视。

enrichment.meaning: put on 穿上；put up 张贴或搭建；put off 推迟；put away 收好。多数此类动词加副词短语遇代词宾语时，代词放中间，如 put it away。
enrichment.example: Put away your books after class.
enrichment.translation: 下课后把书收好。

questions.worked: It's very cold outside. Put on your sweater before you go out.

questions.stem: I don't ____ his words, because he often tells lies.
questions.reason: because he often tells lies 表明不信任他的话，believe his words 即“相信他所说的话”。speak 通常接语言或用 speak to sb；understand 是理解，know 是知道，都不等于相信。

enrichment.meaning: 相信某人所说的话 / 信任某人
enrichment.usage: believe his words 表示相信他说的话。
enrichment.example: I believe her, but I need to check the facts.
enrichment.translation: 我相信她说的话，但我需要核实事实。
enrichment.contrast: believe in 常强调信任、信仰或相信……的存在。

questions.worked: I don't believe his words, because he often tells lies.

questions.stem: It's a good habit to ____ all the things on the desk after finishing your homework.
questions.reason: 做完作业后把桌上的东西“收好”，用 put away。wash away 是冲走；run away 是逃跑，通常不直接接物品作宾语；throw away 是扔掉。good habit 指向整理收纳而非丢弃。

enrichment.meaning: 冲走；冲掉
enrichment.usage: 常用于雨水或洪水把某物冲走。
enrichment.example: The rain washed away the soil.
enrichment.translation: 雨水冲走了泥土。

enrichment.meaning: 逃跑
enrichment.usage: 通常不及物；run away from 从……逃走。
enrichment.example: The dog ran away from the yard.
enrichment.translation: 狗从院子里跑走了。

enrichment.meaning: 收好；放回原处
enrichment.usage: 整理物品；代词宾语放中间，如 put them away。
enrichment.example: Put away your toys after playing.
enrichment.translation: 玩完后把玩具收好。

enrichment.meaning: 扔掉
enrichment.usage: 强调丢弃，不表示整理收纳。
enrichment.example: Don't throw away useful things.
enrichment.translation: 不要扔掉有用的东西。

enrichment.meaning: put on 穿上；put up 张贴或搭建；put off 推迟；put away 收好。多数此类动词加副词短语遇代词宾语时，代词放中间，如 put it away。
enrichment.example: Put away your books after class.
enrichment.translation: 下课后把书收好。

questions.worked: It's a good habit to put away all the things on the desk after finishing your homework.

questions.stem:
— The government is trying to protect the environment now.
— Yeah. It is reported that some factories will be ____.
questions.reason: 工厂为环保而停止运转，用 be shut down。set up 是建立，与题意相反；give up 是放弃；turn off 通常关闭电器、开关等。原整理版已把 shut off 校订为 shut down；此处保留这一校订。

enrichment.meaning: 建立；设立
enrichment.usage: 常接公司、组织、系统等，也可指安装设备。
enrichment.example: They set up a new company.
enrichment.translation: 他们成立了一家新公司。

enrichment.meaning: 关闭；停业
enrichment.usage: 可指工厂、企业停止运转，也可指关机。
enrichment.example: The factory shut down last month.
enrichment.translation: 这家工厂上个月停业了。

enrichment.meaning: 放弃；戒除
enrichment.usage: give up doing；代词宾语放在中间，如 give it up。
enrichment.example: He gave up smoking last year.
enrichment.translation: 他去年戒烟了。

enrichment.meaning: 关闭（电器、水等）
enrichment.usage: 关闭开关；不是“关闭工厂”的常规表达。
enrichment.example: Turn off the TV before you leave.
enrichment.translation: 离开前关掉电视。

questions.worked:
— The government is trying to protect the environment now.
— Yeah. It is reported that some factories will be shut down.

questions.stem: They will ____ in New York in three days.
questions.reason: 已有介词 in，且 New York 是大地点，构成 arrive in New York。get 到达须用 get to；reach 是及物动词，直接接地点，不加 in；go 去某地通常用 go to。will 后接原形 arrive。

enrichment.meaning: 到达较大的地方
enrichment.usage: arrive in a city / country；小地点常用 arrive at。
enrichment.example: We arrived in Beijing before noon.
enrichment.translation: 我们中午前到达北京。
enrichment.contrast: reach 后直接接地点；get to 后接地点；home、here、there 前通常不加介词。

questions.worked: They will arrive in New York in three days.

questions.stem: How long have they ____ the computer?
questions.reason: How long 和现在完成时连用，询问持续拥有电脑多久，要用延续性动词 have，其过去分词为 had，构成 have had。buy、borrow、sell 表示买、借、卖的动作，不能直接与本题表示持续时长的 how long 搭配；C 的 borrow 也不是过去分词。

enrichment.meaning: 已经拥有……多长时间
enrichment.usage: have had 是现在完成时；had 为 have 的过去分词，表示拥有的持续状态。
enrichment.example: I have had this computer for three years.
enrichment.translation: 这台电脑我已经用了三年。
enrichment.contrast: buy 为瞬间动作，不能在此直接用 have bought ... for three years。

enrichment.meaning: begin/leave/buy 等表示瞬间变化的动词，不宜直接用来表示持续了多久；可换成 be on/be away/have 等延续状态。不是说这些动词不能用完成时，而是它们与持续时长结合时需改写。
enrichment.example: The film has been on for ten minutes.
enrichment.translation: 电影已经开始十分钟了。

questions.worked: How long have they had the computer?

questions.stem: It's raining heavily outside. Remember to ____ the raincoat to him when you go there.
questions.reason: when you go there 提示雨衣从说话处带去另一个地方，考试通常选 take。bring 以到说话者或指定参照地点为方向；carry 强调搬运、携带的动作；buy 是购买。本题按 go there 的通常视角选 B，不应把 bring/take 理解成不考虑语境的绝对方位规则。

enrichment.meaning: 带去 / 带来
enrichment.usage: take 常指从说话者这里带到别处；bring 常指带到说话者处或语境中的参照地点。
enrichment.example: Please take this book to Mary.
enrichment.translation: 请把这本书带给玛丽。
enrichment.contrast: 携带过程本身可用 carry；判断方向要看语境。

questions.worked: It's raining heavily outside. Remember to take the raincoat to him when you go there.

questions.stem: She ____ these dogs at home when the Smiths are abroad.
questions.reason: 主人出国期间，她在家“照顾”这些狗，用 looks after。look up 查阅；look for 寻找；look in 顺便探望时一般需搭配 on sb 或 at a place。主语 She 为第三人称单数，四项均需先还原短语再辨义。

enrichment.meaning: 查阅；向上看
enrichment.usage: 查单词等；代词放中间，如 look it up。
enrichment.example: Look up the word in a dictionary.
enrichment.translation: 在词典里查这个词。

enrichment.meaning: 寻找
enrichment.usage: 强调寻找的过程，不保证找到。
enrichment.example: I am looking for my keys.
enrichment.translation: 我正在找钥匙。

enrichment.meaning: 照顾
enrichment.usage: look after sb/sth，相当于 take care of。
enrichment.example: She looks after her little brother.
enrichment.translation: 她照顾她的弟弟。

enrichment.meaning: 顺便探望
enrichment.usage: look in on sb；look in at a place。不能直接把 dogs 接在 in 后表示照顾。
enrichment.example: I'll look in on my aunt tomorrow.
enrichment.translation: 我明天会顺便看望姑妈。

enrichment.meaning: 一般现在时描述经常性动作、状态或客观事实；第三人称单数肯定式常加 -s/-es。疑问、否定用 does/doesn't 时，后面的实义动词恢复原形。客观真理在过去转述中通常仍保留现在时。
enrichment.example: The earth moves around the sun.
enrichment.translation: 地球绕着太阳转。

questions.worked: She looks after these dogs at home when the Smiths are abroad.

questions.stem: It's unnecessary for us to ____ so much on these useless books.
questions.reason: 句型为 sb spend money on sth，这里 so much 指钱，空后已有 on。cost 通常以物作主语；take 表花时间常用 It takes sb time to do；pay 常用 pay money for sth。本题结构直接决定 spend。

enrichment.meaning: 在……上花费时间或金钱
enrichment.usage: 人 + spend + 时间/金钱 + on sth；也可用 spend ... (in) doing sth。
enrichment.example: She spends an hour on English every day.
enrichment.translation: 她每天花一小时学英语。
enrichment.contrast: pay ... for ... 是为……付款；sth costs sb money。

enrichment.meaning: 人 spend 时间/钱 on sth 或 doing sth；物 cost sb 钱；人 pay 钱 for sth；It takes sb 时间 to do sth。根据主语、宾语和介词一起判断，而不只翻译为“花费”。
enrichment.example: I spent twenty yuan on this book.
enrichment.translation: 我花二十元买了这本书。

questions.worked: It's unnecessary for us to spend so much on these useless books.

questions.stem: He ____ living in the countryside to living in the city.
questions.reason: prefer A to B 表示“比起 B 更喜欢 A”，A、B 可为平行的动名词短语。本题 living…to living… 已给出完整搭配，选 prefers。like/enjoy/love 虽均与喜欢有关，但不能照搬 prefer…to… 的比较结构。

enrichment.meaning: 比起 B 更喜欢 A
enrichment.usage: to 是介词，两边形式应平行：prefer doing A to doing B。
enrichment.example: I prefer walking to taking a bus.
enrichment.translation: 比起乘公交，我更喜欢步行。
enrichment.contrast: 不要把这里的 to 当作不定式符号。

enrichment.meaning: prefer A to B 表比起 B 更喜欢 A，A 与 B 通常采用平行结构；比较两个活动可用 prefer doing A to doing B，此处 to 是介词。另一结构为 prefer to do A rather than do B。
enrichment.example: I prefer reading to watching TV.
enrichment.translation: 比起看电视，我更喜欢阅读。

questions.worked: He prefers living in the countryside to living in the city.

questions.stem: The traffic light ____ green and I pulled away.
questions.reason: 交通灯“变绿”，用 turn 作系动词，后接形容词 green；叙述过去的事用 turned。came 和 got 在本题不如 turned 符合颜色变化搭配；B switch 既不是过去式，也不能按本题结构直接接 green。

enrichment.meaning: 变得……
enrichment.usage: turn 作系动词，后接形容词，常描述颜色或状态变化。
enrichment.example: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
enrichment.translation: 树叶在秋天变黄。
enrichment.contrast: turn on/off 是不同的短语，表示开/关。

enrichment.meaning: look/sound/smell/taste/feel 表“看/听/闻/尝/感觉起来”时为系动词，后接形容词，且通常用主动形式描述性质。实际动作的用法另看句法，如 look at。
enrichment.example: The soup tastes good.
enrichment.translation: 这汤尝起来很好。

questions.worked: The traffic light turned green and I pulled away.

questions.stem: He ____ me to give up smoking.
questions.reason: advise sb to do sth 表示建议某人做某事。hope 不能用 hope sb to do；suggest 通常用 suggest doing 或 suggest that…；make 用 make sb do，主动语态省略 to。因此只有 advises 符合 me to give up smoking 的结构。

enrichment.meaning: 建议某人做某事
enrichment.usage: 否定形式 advise sb not to do sth。
enrichment.example: The doctor advised me to get more sleep.
enrichment.translation: 医生建议我多睡一些。
enrichment.contrast: suggest doing sth；不说 suggest sb to do sth。

enrichment.meaning: 放弃某事；停止做某事
enrichment.usage: up 后接名词或动名词；宾语是代词时放在中间，如 give it up。
enrichment.example: He gave up smoking last year.
enrichment.translation: 他去年戒烟了。
enrichment.contrast: give in 是让步、屈服，不能直接代替 give up smoking。

enrichment.meaning: 主动结构 make sb do 用不带 to 的原形；see/hear sb do 侧重全过程，see/hear sb doing 侧重正在进行。make 改被动时不定式的 to 要恢复：be made to do。
enrichment.example: I saw her reading in the library.
enrichment.translation: 我看见她正在图书馆读书。

questions.worked: He advises me to give up smoking.

questions.stem: They ____ him working all day long.
questions.reason: have sb doing sth 表示使某人一直做某事，本题强调 all day long 的持续动作。make sb do 用原形；force/ask sb to do 用带 to 的不定式，不能直接接 him working。本题中的 had 是 have 的过去式。

enrichment.meaning: 让某人一直做某事
enrichment.usage: 强调动作的持续；have sb do sth 则指让某人做某事。
enrichment.example: The coach had us running for ten minutes.
enrichment.translation: 教练让我们连续跑了十分钟。
enrichment.contrast: make sb do sth；被动时为 be made to do sth。

enrichment.meaning: to do 可作宾语、定语或目的状语，结构取决于前面的词。ask sb to do、would like to do 是常见搭配；不定式修饰 something 等时通常放在后面。
enrichment.example: I have something to tell you.
enrichment.translation: 我有件事要告诉你。

questions.worked: They had him working all day long.

questions.stem: He is too young to ____ right from wrong.
questions.reason: tell A from B 表示区分 A 和 B，tell right from wrong 即明辨是非。speak 侧重讲话或讲某种语言；talk 侧重交谈；say 侧重所说内容，均不构成本题固定搭配。

enrichment.meaning: 区分 A 与 B
enrichment.usage: 也可说 tell the difference between A and B。
enrichment.example: Children should learn to tell right from wrong.
enrichment.translation: 孩子应该学会明辨是非。
enrichment.contrast: tell sb sth 另可表示告诉某人某事。

questions.worked: He is too young to tell right from wrong.

questions.stem: At last he ____ a worker.
questions.reason: become 后接带冠词的职业名词，became a worker 表示成了一名工人。turn 表示身份变化时，职业名词前通常不用冠词，如 turned professional；change 常需 change into；grow 作系动词多接形容词，如 grow old。本题选 became。

enrichment.meaning: 成为工人
enrichment.usage: become 后的单数职业名词通常保留冠词；turn 表示变成某职业时通常不用冠词。
enrichment.example: He became a teacher after graduation.
enrichment.translation: 他毕业后成了一名教师。
enrichment.contrast: 原题保留了 a worker，因此用 became。

enrichment.meaning: look/sound/smell/taste/feel 表“看/听/闻/尝/感觉起来”时为系动词，后接形容词，且通常用主动形式描述性质。实际动作的用法另看句法，如 look at。
enrichment.example: The soup tastes good.
enrichment.translation: 这汤尝起来很好。

questions.worked: At last he became a worker.

questions.stem: When did you ____ his letter?
questions.reason: receive a letter 是收到一封信，侧重客观接收。hear from 后面应接写信的人，如 hear from him，不能接 his letter；accept 侧重主动接受提议、邀请等，此处常规搭配不及 receive；hear 是听见。Did 后用原形 receive。

enrichment.meaning: 收到某人的来信或消息
enrichment.usage: hear from 后接人；收到一封信可说 receive a letter from sb。
enrichment.example: I heard from an old friend yesterday.
enrichment.translation: 我昨天收到了一位老朋友的消息。
enrichment.contrast: hear of/about 是听说；receive 后可直接接 letter。

questions.worked: When did you receive his letter?

questions.stem: China has ____ a new look in the last few years.
questions.reason: take on a new look 是呈现新面貌，has 后用过去分词 taken，构成 has taken on。break out 是爆发；take place、happen 表发生，通常不及物，不能把 a new look 直接接在后面。

enrichment.meaning: 爆发
enrichment.usage: 常以战争、火灾、疾病等作主语；通常不及物。
enrichment.example: A fire broke out last night.
enrichment.translation: 昨晚发生了一场火灾。

enrichment.meaning: 发生；举行
enrichment.usage: 常用于安排好的活动；不接宾语，无被动语态。
enrichment.example: The meeting took place on Monday.
enrichment.translation: 会议在星期一举行了。

enrichment.meaning: 发生
enrichment.usage: 通常不及物；常指偶发事件，不能说 happen a new look。
enrichment.example: The accident happened yesterday.
enrichment.translation: 事故发生在昨天。

enrichment.meaning: 呈现；承担；雇用
enrichment.usage: take on a new look 呈现新面貌；take on responsibility 承担责任。
enrichment.example: The town has taken on a new look.
enrichment.translation: 小镇呈现出了新面貌。

questions.worked: China has taken on a new look in the last few years.

questions.stem: She is ____ her best clothes today.
questions.reason: 本题描述她今天“穿着”最好的衣服，选 wearing 表状态。dress 通常接人，如 dress herself；put on 强调穿衣动作，和题干全天穿着的通常理解不合；have on 也表示穿着，但通常不用于进行时，因此 having on 不宜。

enrichment.meaning: 穿着 / 穿上 / 给……穿衣
enrichment.usage: wear 强调状态，put on 强调动作；dress 的宾语常是人。
enrichment.example: She is wearing a blue coat today.
enrichment.translation: 她今天穿着一件蓝色外套。
enrichment.contrast: dress oneself 表示自己穿衣；be dressed in 也可表示穿着。

enrichment.meaning: put on 穿上；put up 张贴或搭建；put off 推迟；put away 收好。多数此类动词加副词短语遇代词宾语时，代词放中间，如 put it away。
enrichment.example: Put away your books after class.
enrichment.translation: 下课后把书收好。

questions.worked: She is wearing her best clothes today.

questions.stem: ____ your child here next time.
questions.reason: here 和 next time 表明下次来这里时把孩子“带来”，常规用 Bring your child here。take 带去；fetch 是去取回，包含往返；get 含义较泛。按课堂 bring…here / take…there 的常见对比取 D。

enrichment.meaning: 把……带到这里
enrichment.usage: here 指当前说话处或语境中的目标参照点，通常搭配 bring。
enrichment.example: Bring your notebook here next time.
enrichment.translation: 下次把你的笔记本带到这里。
enrichment.contrast: take ... there 通常表示把……带到那里。

questions.worked: Bring your child here next time.

questions.stem: The boy was made to ____ for being late for school.
questions.reason: apologize for doing sth 是为做某事而道歉，for being late 与之匹配。pardon、forgive、excuse 通常接被原谅的人或过错，如 forgive sb for doing。make 的被动结构中要还原 to，即 be made to do。

enrichment.meaning: 为……道歉
enrichment.usage: apologize to sb for sth / doing sth。
enrichment.example: He apologized to me for being late.
enrichment.translation: 他因迟到向我道歉。
enrichment.contrast: for 后接动名词；apology 是名词。

questions.worked: The boy was made to apologize for being late for school.

questions.stem: It is hard for them to ____ a good job.
questions.reason: a good job 作宾语，语意为“找到好工作很难”，侧重结果，用 find。look for 强调寻找过程；find out 常指查明事实、原因；discover 常指发现原本未知的事物。本题考试按“找工作/找到工作”的搭配区分选 C。

enrichment.meaning: 寻找 / 找到 / 查明
enrichment.usage: look for 强调过程，find 强调结果，find out 强调查明事实或信息。
enrichment.example: I looked for my keys and finally found them.
enrichment.translation: 我找了钥匙，最后找到了它们。
enrichment.contrast: find out the reason 表示查明原因。

enrichment.meaning: look at 看；look for 寻找；look after 照顾；look like 看起来像；look up 查阅。看同一动词后面的介词或副词如何改变意义，不凭 look 一词猜答案。
enrichment.example: Please look after my dog while I am away.
enrichment.translation: 我不在时，请照顾我的狗。

questions.worked: It is hard for them to find a good job.

questions.stem: How I ____ I were a happy bird.
questions.reason: I were a happy bird 是与现在事实相反的愿望，用 wish + 过去式（be 常用 were）。hope 用于有可能实现的希望，不采用本题虚拟式；want/expect 若接人和动作，常需 sb to do，不接 I were 这一从句结构。

enrichment.meaning: 表达与现在事实相反的愿望
enrichment.usage: wish 后可用过去式表示现在难以实现的愿望；be 在正式表达中常用 were。
enrichment.example: I wish I were a bird.
enrichment.translation: 我希望我是一只鸟。
enrichment.contrast: hope 通常用于有可能实现的愿望。

enrichment.meaning: to do 可作宾语、定语或目的状语，结构取决于前面的词。ask sb to do、would like to do 是常见搭配；不定式修饰 something 等时通常放在后面。
enrichment.example: I have something to tell you.
enrichment.translation: 我有件事要告诉你。

questions.worked: How I wish I were a happy bird.

questions.stem: We ____ to paint the whole house but finished only the front part that day.
questions.reason: 空后是 to paint，需要 set out to do。set about 后接 doing；set up 是建立；set down 是写下、放下。but 后表示只完成了前面部分，不影响 set out 表“开始着手”的搭配判断。

enrichment.meaning: 着手做
enrichment.usage: set about sth/doing sth；不能接 to do 表示着手。
enrichment.example: We set about cleaning the room.
enrichment.translation: 我们着手打扫房间。

enrichment.meaning: 建立；设立
enrichment.usage: 常接公司、组织、系统等，也可指安装设备。
enrichment.example: They set up a new company.
enrichment.translation: 他们成立了一家新公司。

enrichment.meaning: 出发；开始做
enrichment.usage: set out to do sth 着手做某事；set out for a place 动身去某地。
enrichment.example: We set out to solve the problem.
enrichment.translation: 我们着手解决这个问题。

enrichment.meaning: 写下；放下
enrichment.usage: 可指记下内容，近义表达 write down。
enrichment.example: Please set down your ideas.
enrichment.translation: 请写下你的想法。

questions.worked: We set out to paint the whole house but finished only the front part that day.

questions.stem: The earth is our home. We must ____ the land, air and water clean.
questions.reason: keep + 宾语 + 形容词 表示使某物保持某种状态。keep the land, air and water clean 即保持土地、空气和水清洁。change 是改变，share 是分享，notice 是注意到，不能表达题干要求的“保持”。

enrichment.meaning: 使……保持干净
enrichment.usage: keep + 宾语 + 形容词，表示使某人或某物保持某状态。
enrichment.example: We should keep our classroom clean.
enrichment.translation: 我们应该保持教室清洁。
enrichment.contrast: keep doing sth 表示持续做某事。

questions.worked: The earth is our home. We must keep the land, air and water clean.

questions.stem: The VIPs from 21 countries will ____ the APEC meeting in Shanghai this autumn.
questions.reason: 考试最佳答案选 D，attend a meeting 是“出席会议”的常规搭配，不强调组织或具体参与活动。hold 指举办，主语通常是主办者；join 后一般接组织或人。take part in a meeting 在强调积极参与时也可成立，不能教成 meeting 只能与 attend 搭配。本题按出席会议的通常意图选 D。

enrichment.meaning: 举行；握住
enrichment.usage: hold a meeting 的主语通常是组织者；与 attend 出席不同。
enrichment.example: Our school will hold a meeting tomorrow.
enrichment.translation: 我们学校明天将召开会议。

enrichment.meaning: 参加
enrichment.usage: 强调参与活动并发挥作用；会议语境有时也可用，需结合题意。
enrichment.example: We took part in the school sports meeting.
enrichment.translation: 我们参加了学校运动会。

enrichment.meaning: 加入
enrichment.usage: join a club/the army；join sb；join in an activity。
enrichment.example: She joined the English club.
enrichment.translation: 她加入了英语社团。

enrichment.meaning: 出席；参加
enrichment.usage: 直接接 meeting/class/school 等，不加 in。
enrichment.example: He attended the meeting yesterday.
enrichment.translation: 他昨天出席了会议。

questions.worked: The VIPs from 21 countries will attend the APEC meeting in Shanghai this autumn.

questions.stem: Water ____ after the big rain.
questions.reason: 雨后水位“上涨”，rise 是不及物动词，过去式 rose，不需要宾语，也不使用被动。raise 是及物动词，表示把某物抬高，通常需宾语；was raised 指水被人为提升，与本题自然上涨的语境不同。

enrichment.meaning: 上升 / 使……上升
enrichment.usage: rise 不及物：rise—rose—risen；raise 及物：raise—raised—raised。
enrichment.example: The water level rose after the rain.
enrichment.translation: 雨后水位上升了。
enrichment.contrast: raise your hand 表示举手；不要把自然上涨写成 was risen。

questions.worked: Water rose after the big rain.

questions.stem: Tim ____ until Betty arrived very late.
questions.reason: waited until… 表示一直等待到某时，符合“贝蒂很晚才到，他一直等着”的常规理解。didn't stay until 通常否定待到那个时间；left/hurried off 是离开动作，不符合本题与 until 连接表达持续等待的结构。

enrichment.meaning: 一直等到
enrichment.usage: until 引出等待持续到的时间点或事件。
enrichment.example: We waited until the rain stopped.
enrichment.translation: 我们一直等到雨停。
enrichment.contrast: not ... until 表示直到……才……，注意否定结构的意义。

questions.worked: Tim waited until Betty arrived very late.

questions.stem: A full moon ____ in the sky that night.
questions.reason: hang 表示月亮“悬挂在天空中”可作不及物动词，过去式 hung，直接用主动形式。was hung 是被人悬挂，通常描述物件；hanging 单独使用缺谓语；hanged 通常用于绞死人的过去式或分词，不能描述月亮。

enrichment.meaning: 悬挂；挂着
enrichment.usage: 表示悬挂时，过去式和过去分词为 hung。
enrichment.example: A picture hung on the wall.
enrichment.translation: 墙上挂着一幅画。
enrichment.contrast: hanged 通常用于“绞死”这一义项。

questions.worked: A full moon hung in the sky that night.

questions.stem: Is this a photo of your daughter? She looks ____ in the pink dress!
questions.reason: look 表示“看起来”是系动词，后接形容词作表语，lovely 是可爱的。quietly、politely、happily 都是副词，不能在这里充当描述她外观的表语。注意 lovely 虽以 -ly 结尾，仍是形容词。

enrichment.meaning: 看起来……
enrichment.usage: look 作系动词，后接形容词作表语。
enrichment.example: The girl looks happy in her new dress.
enrichment.translation: 这个女孩穿着新裙子，看起来很开心。
enrichment.contrast: lovely 是形容词；不能因 -ly 结尾就把它当副词。

enrichment.meaning: look/sound/smell/taste/feel 表“看/听/闻/尝/感觉起来”时为系动词，后接形容词，且通常用主动形式描述性质。实际动作的用法另看句法，如 look at。
enrichment.example: The soup tastes good.
enrichment.translation: 这汤尝起来很好。

questions.worked: Is this a photo of your daughter? She looks lovely in the pink dress!

questions.stem: Song Zuying's voice is very sweet and her songs ____ very beautiful.
questions.reason: 歌曲是用耳朵听的，sound 表示“听起来”，作系动词后接 beautiful。taste 尝起来，smell 闻起来，feel 感觉或摸起来，感官意义均不符合 songs。

enrichment.meaning: 听起来……
enrichment.usage: sound 作系动词，后接形容词。
enrichment.example: That idea sounds interesting.
enrichment.translation: 那个主意听起来很有趣。
enrichment.contrast: taste、smell、feel、look 也可以作感官系动词。

enrichment.meaning: look/sound/smell/taste/feel 表“看/听/闻/尝/感觉起来”时为系动词，后接形容词，且通常用主动形式描述性质。实际动作的用法另看句法，如 look at。
enrichment.example: The soup tastes good.
enrichment.translation: 这汤尝起来很好。

questions.worked: Song Zuying's voice is very sweet and her songs sound very beautiful.

questions.stem: There ____ many students in the library after school every day.
questions.reason: There be 句型中，be 与后面的主语一致；many students 是复数，且 every day 表示日常情况，用 are。has/have 表“拥有”，不能替换此处 be；is 与复数 students 不一致。

enrichment.usage: there be 表示某处存在某人或物，be 的形式与后面的主语相应。
enrichment.example: There are many books on the desk.
enrichment.translation: 桌上有许多书。
enrichment.contrast: have 表示拥有；不把 There have 直接当作 There are 使用。

enrichment.meaning: 谓语与主语中心词一致，不被中间的 with/of 等修饰语干扰。and 连接独立对象通常用复数；a pair of shoes 的中心是 pair，用单数，而 shoes 单独作主语用复数。
enrichment.example: A pair of shoes is under the bed.
enrichment.translation: 床下有一双鞋。

questions.worked: There are many students in the library after school every day.

questions.stem: Playing in the water ____ lots of fun on a hot summer day.
questions.reason: Playing in the water 整个动名词短语作主语，按一个活动看待，谓语用单数 is。fun 在此为不可数名词，lots of fun 作表语，表示“有很多乐趣”。不能看见 lots 就误选复数 are。

enrichment.meaning: 动名词短语作主语
enrichment.usage: 单个动名词短语作主语时，谓语通常用单数。
enrichment.example: Reading English every day is useful.
enrichment.translation: 每天读英语很有用。
enrichment.contrast: 主语是整个活动，不根据短语中的复数名词决定谓语。

enrichment.meaning: 谓语与主语中心词一致，不被中间的 with/of 等修饰语干扰。and 连接独立对象通常用复数；a pair of shoes 的中心是 pair，用单数，而 shoes 单独作主语用复数。
enrichment.example: A pair of shoes is under the bed.
enrichment.translation: 床下有一双鞋。

questions.worked: Playing in the water is lots of fun on a hot summer day.

questions.stem:
— Do you have to get up early in the morning?
— Yes, I ____. I can't be late for school.
questions.reason: have to 在一般现在时的问答中使用助动词 do/does。问句 Do you have to…? 的肯定简答为 Yes, I do。这里 do 代替 have to get up early；can、have、am 均与问句助动词不匹配。

enrichment.meaning: 不得不；必须
enrichment.usage: have to 是实义动词结构，一般现在时问答用 do / does。
enrichment.example: Do you have to leave now? Yes, I do.
enrichment.translation: 你现在必须离开吗？是的。
enrichment.contrast: 一般过去时用 had to，疑问句使用 did。

enrichment.meaning: 一般现在时描述经常性动作、状态或客观事实；第三人称单数肯定式常加 -s/-es。疑问、否定用 does/doesn't 时，后面的实义动词恢复原形。客观真理在过去转述中通常仍保留现在时。
enrichment.example: The earth moves around the sun.
enrichment.translation: 地球绕着太阳转。

enrichment.meaning: 起床；起身
enrichment.usage: 既可表示早晨起床，也可表示从座位上站起。
enrichment.example: He got up and offered me his seat.
enrichment.translation: 他站起来，把座位让给了我。

questions.worked:
— Do you have to get up early in the morning?
— Yes, I do. I can't be late for school.

questions.stem:
— There ____ a charity show this weekend. Would you like to join us?
— Of course. I'd love to.
questions.reason: There will be… 表示“将有……”，this weekend 在本题常规语境中指即将到来的周末。There be 不能改成 There will have；has 同样不属于此句型。is 在明确日程语境有时可表将来，但本题缺少相应安排说明，考试选 will be。

enrichment.meaning: 将会有……
enrichment.usage: there be 的将来时结构；will 后接 be。
enrichment.example: There will be a school show next Friday.
enrichment.translation: 下周五将有一场学校演出。
enrichment.contrast: 不要写 There will have，除非使用别的完整句式。

enrichment.meaning: will + 原形表示将来；there will be 表示将有，不能用 there will have。be going to 后也接原形，be 仍随主语变化。
enrichment.example: There will be a meeting tomorrow.
enrichment.translation: 明天将有一场会议。

questions.worked:
— There will be a charity show this weekend. Would you like to join us?
— Of course. I'd love to.

questions.stem: Mary, I ____ John of his promise to help you.
questions.reason: remind sb of sth 表示提醒某人某事，这里是提醒约翰不要忘记帮助你的承诺。tell sb about sth 告诉某事；warn sb of sth 警告危险；advise sb to do 建议做。promise 提示“唤起记忆”，用 reminded。

enrichment.meaning: 使某人想起某事；提醒某人某事
enrichment.usage: remind sb to do sth 表示提醒某人去做某事。
enrichment.example: This photo reminds me of my school days.
enrichment.translation: 这张照片让我想起学生时代。
enrichment.contrast: of 后接名词或动名词；to do 表示待做的事。

questions.worked: Mary, I reminded John of his promise to help you.

questions.stem: They are broadening the bridge to ____ the flow of traffic.
questions.reason: 拓宽桥梁的目的是“加快”车流通行，用 speed up。put off 推迟；turn on 打开电器；work out 算出或解决。to 后用动词原形，四项结构都可，需依靠目的和语义排除。

enrichment.meaning: 推迟
enrichment.usage: put off doing；代词宾语放中间。
enrichment.example: They put off holding the meeting.
enrichment.translation: 他们推迟了开会。

enrichment.meaning: 加快
enrichment.usage: 可以及物或不及物，反义表达 slow down。
enrichment.example: The new road will speed up traffic.
enrichment.translation: 新道路将加快车辆通行。

enrichment.meaning: 打开（电器、水等）
enrichment.usage: 指接通电源或开启开关，与 turn off 相对。
enrichment.example: Please turn on the light.
enrichment.translation: 请开灯。

enrichment.meaning: 算出；解决；锻炼
enrichment.usage: work out a problem 解决问题；work out at the gym 在健身房锻炼。
enrichment.example: We worked out the answer together.
enrichment.translation: 我们一起算出了答案。

enrichment.meaning: put on 穿上；put up 张贴或搭建；put off 推迟；put away 收好。多数此类动词加副词短语遇代词宾语时，代词放中间，如 put it away。
enrichment.example: Put away your books after class.
enrichment.translation: 下课后把书收好。

questions.worked: They are broadening the bridge to speed up the flow of traffic.

questions.stem: I ____ a bank account after I made $1,000 by doing a part-time job during the summer vacation.
questions.reason: open a bank account 是开立银行账户，after 从句为一般过去时，主句也用 opened。borrow 是借入，enter 是进入或录入，order 是订购或命令，都不构成“开户”的常用搭配。已删除 entered 后多余句点。

enrichment.meaning: 开立银行账户
enrichment.usage: open an account with a bank；account 是可数名词。
enrichment.example: I opened a bank account last week.
enrichment.translation: 我上周开了一个银行账户。
enrichment.contrast: 此处不使用 borrow an account。

enrichment.meaning: 明确过去时间内发生的动作或状态用一般过去时。实义动词否定和疑问常借助 did，此时原动词恢复原形；be 则用 was/were，并按主语选形式。
enrichment.example: He went to school yesterday. Did he walk there?
enrichment.translation: 他昨天去上学了。他是走去的吗？

questions.worked: I opened a bank account after I made $1,000 by doing a part-time job during the summer vacation.

questions.stem: Knowledge and learning are important if we want to be successful, but they may also ____ our thinking.
questions.reason: 前文说知识和学习重要，but 引出可能的负面作用，limit our thinking 表示限制思维，与这一转折关系最吻合。direct 是引导，change 是改变，improve 是改善；后三者中 improve 明显正面，direct/change 也不如 limit 表达这里的局限性。

enrichment.meaning: 限制某人的思维
enrichment.usage: limit 作及物动词，直接接宾语；本题 but 提示潜在的不利影响。
enrichment.example: Old habits may limit our thinking.
enrichment.translation: 旧习惯可能限制我们的思维。
enrichment.contrast: improve 是改善；要结合转折关系判断词义。

questions.worked: Knowledge and learning are important if we want to be successful, but they may also limit our thinking.

questions.stem: As the story ____, the truth about the strange figure is slowly discovered.
questions.reason: as the story develops 表示随着故事情节发展，后文 is slowly discovered 与逐步展开相呼应。begins 是开始，ends 是结束，不能同样突出持续发展；happens 通常说事件发生，story happens 不是这里的惯用搭配。

enrichment.meaning: 随着故事的发展
enrichment.usage: as 表示随着；develop 在这里是不及物动词，表示情节逐步展开。
enrichment.example: As the story develops, we learn more about the hero.
enrichment.translation: 随着故事展开，我们对主人公有了更多了解。
enrichment.contrast: develop 也可作及物动词，表示发展某事、培养某种能力。

enrichment.meaning: 发生
enrichment.usage: 通常不及物；常指偶发事件，不能说 happen a new look。
enrichment.example: The accident happened yesterday.
enrichment.translation: 事故发生在昨天。

questions.worked: As the story develops, the truth about the strange figure is slowly discovered.

questions.stem: You are old enough to ____ your own living.
questions.reason: earn one's living 是谋生、维持生计，one's 随主语变为 your。win 赢得比赛或奖项，gain 获得经验等，take 拿取，均不能替换这一固定搭配中的 earn。

enrichment.meaning: 谋生
enrichment.usage: one's 随主语变化；也可说 earn a living。
enrichment.example: She earns her living by teaching English.
enrichment.translation: 她靠教英语谋生。
enrichment.contrast: by 后接动名词，表示方式。

questions.worked: You are old enough to earn your own living.

questions.stem: Jenny was looking for a seat when, luckily, a man ____ and left.
questions.reason: 前文说珍妮正在找座位，后文 left 表明一名男子“站起来并离开”，用 got up。took up 是占用或开始从事，shut up 是闭嘴，set up 是建立；其他短语均不表示让出座位的起身动作。

enrichment.meaning: 占用；开始从事
enrichment.usage: take up time/space；take up a hobby。
enrichment.example: This desk takes up too much space.
enrichment.translation: 这张桌子占用太多空间。

enrichment.meaning: 起床；起身
enrichment.usage: 既可表示早晨起床，也可表示从座位上站起。
enrichment.example: He got up and offered me his seat.
enrichment.translation: 他站起来，把座位让给了我。

enrichment.meaning: 闭嘴
enrichment.usage: 口语命令语气粗鲁；不表示从座位上站起。
enrichment.example: He told the noisy boy to shut up.
enrichment.translation: 他叫那个吵闹的男孩闭嘴。

enrichment.meaning: 建立；设立
enrichment.usage: 常接公司、组织、系统等，也可指安装设备。
enrichment.example: They set up a new company.
enrichment.translation: 他们成立了一家新公司。

enrichment.meaning: 进行时结构是 be + 动词 -ing；现在进行用 am/is/are，过去进行用 was/were。具体时间点、Look/Listen 或上下文可提示进行意义，不能漏掉 be 或只写 -ing。
enrichment.example: I was reading when she called.
enrichment.translation: 她打电话时我正在读书。

questions.worked: Jenny was looking for a seat when, luckily, a man got up and left.

questions.stem: The majority of people in the town strongly ____ the plan to build a playground for children.
questions.reason: support the plan 是支持计划，strongly 表示强烈地，最符合多数人对计划所持态度的表达。consider 是考虑，confirm 是证实，submit 是提交。仅从语法看部分动词可接 plan，但结合 majority 和 strongly 的态度语境，学校考试通常选 support。

enrichment.meaning: 支持一项计划
enrichment.usage: support 作动词，直接接人、观点或计划。
enrichment.example: Most parents support the plan.
enrichment.translation: 大多数家长支持这项计划。
enrichment.contrast: consider 是考虑；confirm 是确认；submit 是提交。

questions.worked: The majority of people in the town strongly support the plan to build a playground for children.

notes: 第24题原无正确选项，已将 C 改为 not be。填空部分情境不足的题允许多个合理答案。原 be 动词练习要求只用 am/is/are，但后半部分有明确过去时间，已修正题目要求。
本修订版：原有选择题采用一个考试建议答案；不严谨题的其他有效读法在解析中说明。真正缺少判定依据的题目标为待确认，不作对错评价。填空、写作和讲解保留原题型。

reference.text: 一、选择填空

questions.stem:
— Can you speak Japanese?
— No, I ____.
questions.reason: can 的否定简答 can't。

enrichment.phrase: 情态动词的形式与简答
enrichment.meaning: can/could/may/must/will 等情态动词后接原形，不随第三人称单数加 -s，也不加 to。简答一般沿用问句相应的情态动词；礼貌 Could I 请求的允许回答通常用 can，而非表示过去能力的 could。
enrichment.example: Can she swim? Yes, she can.
enrichment.translation: 她会游泳吗？会。

enrichment.meaning: can 常表能力或许可，may 表许可或可能，must 表必须或肯定推测；can't 可表不能或否定推测，must not 是禁止。先根据上下文判断是在谈能力、规定还是推测，不能只按中文“能”机械选词。
enrichment.example: It may rain, so take an umbrella.
enrichment.translation: 可能会下雨，所以带把伞吧。

— No, I can't.

enrichment.translation: 你不必着急，但不能迟到。

questions.reason: 邀请或请求时 some 常用于疑问句。

enrichment.translation: 对不起，我迟到了。没关系。

questions.stem: I prefer playing ____ piano to playing ____ basketball.

enrichment.translation: 我可以用你的笔吗？当然可以。

enrichment.meaning: some 常用于肯定句及期待肯定答复的请求；any 常用于否定和一般疑问。someone/somebody 指某人，everyone/everybody 指人人，no one/nobody 指无人；不能只看句子是不是肯定就忽略具体含义。

questions.stem: The earliest frogs lived about ____ million years ago.

context.text: Frogs are animals that can live both in water and on land. There are more than 5,000 kinds of frogs on the earth. The earliest known frogs lived about 190 million years ago, and the frogs today still look the same. Here are some fun things that you might not know about frogs. Enjoy!
The Biggest and the Smallest Frogs

Some frogs can be very big. The biggest kind of frog is the Goliath Frog in West Africa. Its body can be nearly 30 cm long, about the size of a large cat. The Gold Frog and the Poison Frog are the smallest frogs in the world. They are less than 1 cm long. Though the Poison Frog is very small, it is not weak at all. It is dangerous. Any animal that eats it will die very soon.
The Best Jumpers

Frogs are very good at jumping. They developed jumping legs so that they would not be eaten by other large animals. Using their big strong legs, most frogs can jump over twenty times their own length. It is like a person jumping over about 30.48 m. options.text: a door with a bell on it

context.text: Long, long ago there was a very foolish thief. Do you know what he did one day? When he wanted to steal the bell on his neighbor's door, he walked up to the door, took hold of the bell and pulled hard. The bell made a very loud noise. The thief was afraid and went home.

Then he sat down to think. "I must do something about the noise," he said. He thought and thought. At last he had an idea. "Ah, I'll put some cotton in my ears. Then I won't be able to hear the noise." The next day he went to the door of his neighbor and took hold of the bell. This time he pulled even harder. The bell rang loudly, but the thief did not hear anything. With another hard pull he got the bell out. Just then the neighbor came running out.
"Steal my bell? I'll teach you a lesson," the angry man shouted. And he hit the thief on the nose.
The foolish thief did not know how the neighbor found out he was stealing the bell. "Why did he come out just then?" he wondered.

context.text: Long long ago, there lived a poor farmer who had a flock of geese（一群鹅）. Every morning his wife led the geese to the pool. Then she came back home and put the eggs that the geese had laid into a basket. And they made some money by selling those eggs at the market.

One day, when the farmer's wife called the geese back to their home in the evening, she saw a very different-looking goose in the flock. "Where did it come from?" she wondered. However, she went to her own room telling nothing to anyone.

The next morning, she led the geese to the pool and took the eggs as usual. To her surprise, there was a shiny golden egg among all the other eggs! She became so excited that she rushed to her husband and told him everything clearly at once. They sold it at a high price at the market.
From then on, every morning the couple got a golden egg and they soon became rich. The farmer and his wife were happy all the time.
But one morning, the farmer got an idea and thought, "Why do I take just one egg a day? Why can't I take all of them at once and make a lot of money?"

The farmer's wife also agreed and decided to cut the goose's stomach for the eggs. They killed the goose and opened its stomach, only to find that she was just like every other goose. She didn't have any golden eggs inside her. The farmer, realizing his foolish mistake, cried over the lost resource!

The next morning, she led the geese to the pool and took the eggs as usual. To her surprise, there was a shiny golden egg among all the other eggs! She became so excited that she rushed to her husband and told him everything clearly at once. They sold it at a high price at the market.
From then on, every morning the couple got a golden egg and they soon became rich. The farmer and his wife were happy all the time.
But one morning, the farmer got an idea and thought, "Why do I take just one egg a day? Why can't I take all of them at once and make a lot of money?"

The farmer's wife also agreed and decided to cut the goose's stomach for the eggs. They killed the goose and opened its stomach, only to find that she was just like every other goose. She didn't have any golden eggs inside her. The farmer, realizing his foolish mistake, cried over the lost resource!

questions.stem: Volunteers using a smartphone took ____ more calories.

context.text: Using a smartphone at mealtimes is making us fat, say scientists. Researchers have found that men and women took 15 percent more calories（热量） when looking at their phones while eating. They also ate more fatty food.

The study suggests that looking at a phone screen may distract（使分心） people from how much food they are actually eating. "It may prevent the brain from correctly understanding the amount of food taken," said researchers who watched the volunteers eating alone. Sixty-two volunteers, men and women, aged 18 to 28, joined the study. They were invited to have different types of food-from healthy ones to soft drinks and chocolate-until they were satisfied. Only three of the volunteers were recorded eating with no distraction of a smartphone.

The volunteers ate 535 calories without the distraction of a smartphone but 616 when using a mobile. When using their mobiles, the volunteers also took 10 percent more fatty foods. "Smartphone use during a meal increased calorie and fat intake," said Marcio Gilberto Zangeronimoa, a lead author of the study, carried out at the Federal University of Lavras in Brazil and University Medical Center Utrecht in the Netherlands.
He added, "Smartphones have become the main distractors during meals, even early in childhood. It's making us fat."

questions.evidence: Researchers have found that men and women took 15 percent more calories（热量） when looking at their phones while eating.

questions.stem: How long have engineers spent on the research and development of agricultural robots?

context.text: Farming has long been closely connected with hard-working farmers. Today, there are also agricultural（农业的） robots and all kinds of other intelligent machines, marking a great change in agricultural practices. Here, robots operated（操作） by engineers have taken the place of traditional farming methods.

Over the past seven years, the engineers have been working on the research and development of robots. As a result, they succeeded in creating more than 60 kinds of agricultural robots. These robots can complete tasks from planting to harvesting. They can smoothly walk in different kinds of fields. And their artificial intelligence operating system（人工智能操作系统） serves as the brain to plan their movements.

Farmers simply need to log on to  the system through the WeChat mini program on their mobile phones and turn on the robots. "I grew up in the countryside, and I know farm work can be very tiring, " said Wang Jinyue, head of the Diantian agricultural cooperative. Unlike in the past, agricultural robots can help farm work well today. These agricultural robots operate efficiently, quickly and tirelessly. They can make the farmers' jobs easy.

According to the report, the contribution rate  of agricultural scientific and technological progress was over 62 percent in 2022. It means that the development of science and technology is very important to agriculture. So our future agriculture must be science and technology agriculture.

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: excellent 以元音音素 /e/ 开头，故用 an，而不是按字母 e 之外的规则判断。

enrichment.meaning: a/an 根据紧随其后的发音选择：辅音音素前 a，元音音素前 an。university、useful 以 /j/ 开头，用 a；hour、honest 的 h 不发音，用 an。不是按第一个字母是不是元音字母来判断。
enrichment.example: He is a university student. She is an honest girl.
enrichment.translation: 他是大学生，她是诚实的女孩。

questions.stem: good at all subject. He plays basketball quite well. 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: all 这里表示所有科目，subject 是可数名词，应为复数 subjects。

enrichment.phrase: 可数名词与量词的复数
enrichment.meaning: 数词大于一或 some/many 等修饰可数名词时，名词通常需复数。不可数名词用量词计数时变化的是量词：two pieces of bread，而不是 breads。所有格与复数不是同一回事。
enrichment.example: She bought two pairs of shoes.
enrichment.translation: 她买了两双鞋。

questions.stem: He has already won many basketball matches. 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: has already won 为现在完成时，won 是 win 的过去分词；many 后 basketball matches 为复数，本行无错。

enrichment.meaning: 现在完成时把过去经历、结果或持续状态与现在联系起来；过去完成时则放在另一个过去时间之前。have/has 后是过去分词，不是统一加 -ed；already、yet、never、since 等需结合语境判断。
enrichment.example: She has already finished her homework.
enrichment.translation: 她已经做完作业了。

questions.stem: Last week, he gets his fifth gold medal. 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: Last week 是明确过去时间，gets 改为不规则过去式 got；不能保留现在时第三人称单数。

enrichment.meaning: 一般过去时说明在过去完成的动作。明确的 ago/yesterday/last week 是常见线索；疑问与否定用 did 时，实义动词用原形。并列过去动作通常保持同一时态。
enrichment.example: Did you see him yesterday? No, I didn't.
enrichment.translation: 你昨天见到他了吗？没有。

questions.stem: We all took pride him. Although it rained that day, 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: 固定短语 take pride in sb/sth 表为……自豪；pride 后缺少介词 in。

enrichment.meaning: 为……感到自豪
enrichment.usage: in 后接名词或动名词；be proud of 意义相近。
enrichment.example: We take pride in our school.
enrichment.translation: 我们为学校感到自豪。
enrichment.contrast: pride 是名词；proud 是形容词。

questions.stem: I went to watching the match. It was 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: went to watch 表去观看的目的，to 后用动词原形 watch；这里 to 不是介词。

enrichment.meaning: to do 可作宾语、定语或目的状语，结构取决于前面的词。ask sb to do、would like to do 是常见搭配；不定式修饰 something 等时通常放在后面。
enrichment.example: I have something to tell you.
enrichment.translation: 我有件事要告诉你。

questions.stem: a great game and I enjoyed me so much. 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: enjoy oneself 表玩得开心；主语 I 与宾语同指自己，宾语用反身代词 myself。

enrichment.meaning: 主语和宾语指同一人或同一群体时可用反身代词；by oneself 表示独自、亲自。单复数要匹配：you 一人用 yourself，多人用 yourselves。
enrichment.example: The children finished the work by themselves.
enrichment.translation: 孩子们独立完成了这项工作。

questions.stem: Li Yang is kind and he is friendly for everyone. 改错 ____

context.text: 每行至多一处错误。正确则写 正确；有错则改词 增词或删词。以下错误为练习内容，特意保留。

questions.reason: be friendly to sb 表对某人友好；friendly 是形容词，搭配介词 to。

enrichment.meaning: 对……友好
enrichment.usage: to 后接人或其他对象。
enrichment.example: She is always friendly to new students.
enrichment.translation: 她对新同学总是很友好。
enrichment.contrast: friendly 是形容词，不能因为词尾 -ly 就把它当作副词。

questions.stem: 根据以下要求完成书面表达。

context.text: 国家已将劳动教育纳入中小学国家课程。学校对学生将如何开展劳动活动进行了调查，请根据下列要点写一篇至少80词的短文。开头已给出，不计入总词数。不要出现真实姓名和学校名称。
1 60%的学生打算打扫街道和公园，让城市更美。
2 40%的学生计划帮助父母做家务，如倒垃圾 浇花 打扫房间。
3 你想学习基本生活技能，如做饭 整理床铺 洗衣。
4 说明你对劳动教育的认识，例如让校园生活更有意义 使学生更独立。
参考词 labor activities 生活技能 life skills 劳动教育 labor education 独立 independent
Our school did a survey among the students about our plans for labor activities. Here are the results.

questions.reason:
作文为开放题，末尾给出范文和要点检查，不作唯一答案。
写作检查：逐项回应题目给出的调查结果和个人计划，60%与40%的比例不可互换；使用将来计划表达活动，并说明劳动教育的意义。范文只是参考，表达准确、内容完整的其他写法也可。检查至少80词、段落衔接、主谓一致和标点，不出现真实姓名与学校名。
questions.essay:
Our school did a survey among the students about our plans for labor activities. Here are the results.
Sixty percent of the students are interested in cleaning streets and parks. They want to make our city more beautiful. Forty percent plan to help their parents with housework, such as taking out the rubbish, watering flowers and cleaning rooms. As for me, I would like to learn some basic life skills. I plan to learn how to cook, make my bed and wash my clothes. I think labor education makes our school life more colorful and meaningful. It also helps us become more independent. We should take an active part in labor activities and learn to care for others.
要点核查 60%打扫公共场所 40%帮助父母 个人生活技能 劳动教育意义。范文正文超过80词，开放题允许其他符合要求的表达。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 01 冠词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: China has helped end 70% of poverty worldwide since ________ late 1970s, according to ________ World Bank.
questions.reason: 年代用 the late 1970s；World Bank 为特定国际机构，名称前用 the，故两空均填 the。

questions.stem: ______ medical book Tian Hui Yi Jian by Bian Que and Cang Gong has come out in Chengdu.
questions.reason: Tian Hui Yi Jian 限定了具体是哪一本医书，medical book 前用 the 表特指。

questions.stem: Ben watched Tom and Jerry yesterday. ________ cartoon made him laugh.
questions.reason: 前句已提到 Tom and Jerry 这部动画，后句再次指它，用 The cartoon。

questions.stem: Natalia, ___________exchange student from Spain, is ___________university student in Sichuan now.
questions.reason: exchange 以元音音素开头，用 an；university 以 /j/ 开头，用 a，故 an; a。

questions.stem: There is _________ bank across from the hospital.
questions.reason: bank 是首次提到的单数可数名词，且以辅音音素开头，填 a。

questions.stem: I usually have ____ egg and some bread for breakfast.
questions.reason: egg 以元音音素开头，单数前用 an。原句 an some bread 中的 an 应为 and，与本空无关。

questions.stem: I got a dog yesterday as a birthday gift. ________ dog is very cute and I like it.
questions.reason: 前句 a dog 首次提及，后句特指这只狗，填 The。

questions.stem: Academician (院士) Zhong Nanshan said Doctor Li Wenliang was _______hero when a reporter had __________interview with him.
questions.reason: hero 以 /h/ 开头，用 a；interview 以元音音素开头，have an interview 表示接受一次采访。

questions.stem:
— Can your sister play__ chess?
— No, she can't, but she can play __ piano.
questions.reason: play chess 表下棋，棋类前不加冠词；play the piano 表弹钢琴，乐器前用 the。

questions.stem:
— Did you take our son to get _______ X-ray, Bill?
— Yes, and I also told him _______ ways of keeping safe in P. E. class.
questions.reason: X 的名称读 /eks/，故一次 X 光检查为 an X-ray；后空特指体育课中保持安全的方法，用 the。

questions.stem: The young man plays ________ violin very well, but he plays ________ basketball badly.
questions.reason: 演奏小提琴用 play the violin；打篮球用 play basketball，球类前不用冠词。

questions.stem:
— Was there ______ fire in the shopping mall last night?
— Yes, luckily, it was not ______ very big one. No one got hurt.
questions.reason: fire 在此表示一场火灾，为可数用法，填 a；one 指一次火灾，very 以辅音音素开头，也用 a。

questions.stem:
— Let's play ___________ chess now.
— That's boring. How about playing ___________ piano?
questions.reason: play chess 不加冠词；play the piano 在乐器前加 the。

questions.stem: Players were glad to meet at _______ 24th Winter Olympic Games (冬奥会) in Beijing.
questions.reason: 24th 为序数词，特指第24届冬奥会，前面用 the。

questions.stem: In many languages, __________ word "mama" sounds like nana.
questions.reason: 后置的 “mama” 明确限定 word，指这个特定的词，填 the。

questions.stem:
— Taiwan is ______island and it is ______largest one of China.
— Yes, it is part of China.
questions.reason: island 以元音音素开头，填 an；largest 是最高级，前面用 the。

questions.stem:
— What do you think of the boy over there?
— I think he's _________ amazing boy with many strange ideas.
questions.reason: amazing 以元音音素开头，泛指一个令人惊奇的男孩，用 an。

questions.stem:
— My home is not far from the school, so it's a good idea to go to school by ________ bike.
— Yes, and you can also keep fit at the same time.
questions.reason: by bike 表骑自行车出行，by 后的交通工具名词不加冠词。

questions.stem:
— Have you ever worked as _________ volunteer during the COVID-19 pandemic?
— Yes, it was ________ unforgettable experience for me.
questions.reason: volunteer 以辅音音素开头，填 a；unforgettable 以元音音素开头，填 an。

questions.stem:
— Would you like to take ______ walk with me right now?
— Sorry, I have to meet some friends.
questions.reason: take a walk 是固定搭配，意为散步，walk 此处为单数可数名词。

questions.stem:
— Jenny, why not go for ________ picnic this Saturday?
— Sounds great.
questions.reason: go for a picnic 表示去野餐，picnic 前用 a。

questions.stem:
— Beijing is ________ only city to hold the Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
— Yes, so it's called ________ city of "Double Olympics."
questions.reason: the only city 表唯一的城市；后空特指“双奥之城”，用 the city of “Double Olympics”。

questions.stem: My brother Tom can play ______ ping-pong well, but he can't play ______ violin.
questions.reason: play ping-pong 不加冠词；play the violin 在乐器名前加 the。

questions.stem:
— Will you send me ________ e-mail when you get to Wuhan?
— Of course, I will.
questions.reason: e-mail 以元音音素 /iː/ 开头，泛指一封邮件，用 an。

questions.stem: She usually has ________ egg and some porridge for ________ breakfast.
questions.reason: egg 前填 an；breakfast 泛指日常早餐，前面不用冠词。选项中的反斜线表示不填。

questions.stem:
— Are you free on weekends?
— Yes, I am going to have ________ picnic on ________ Sunday.
questions.reason: have a picnic 表野餐；星期名称 Sunday 前不加冠词，故 a; /。

questions.stem: ________ clever girl Kitty is! She can come up with some creative ways to finish the project.
questions.reason: 感叹句中心词 girl 是单数可数名词，结构为 What a + 形容词 + girl + 主语 + 谓语。

questions.stem: My brother often plays ________ football with his classmates after school.
questions.reason: play football 表踢足球，球类运动前不加冠词。

questions.stem: After ______ school, I bought ______ present for my mother.
questions.reason: after school 表放学后，不加冠词；泛指给母亲的一份礼物，用 a present。

questions.stem:
— What are you going to be when you grow up, Lily?
— I'm going to be ________ astronaut like Wang Yaping.
questions.reason: astronaut 以元音音素开头，表示将来当一名宇航员，用 an。

questions.stem: My little brother, _____ eight-year-old boy, is very clever.
questions.reason: eight-year-old 的起始音为 /eɪ/，修饰单数 boy，前用 an。

questions.stem: Shenzhen was________ small village many years ago.
questions.reason: 这里叙述深圳过去是一个小村庄，small 以辅音音素开头，填 a。

questions.stem:
— Do you know how to spell ______ word "miaow" in English?
— Yes. It begins with ______ "m".
questions.reason: “miaow” 限定具体的 word，填 the；字母 m 读 /em/，以元音音素开头，填 an。

questions.stem: Lucy is ____ eleven-year-old girl and she goes to school on ____ foot every day.
questions.reason: eleven 以元音音素开头，填 an；on foot 是固定表达，不加冠词。

questions.stem:
— Lisa, are you going to play ____ piano after school this afternoon?
— No, I'm going to play ____ football with my sister.
questions.reason: 本题两处应理解为 play ___ piano 和 play ___ football，分别填 the 和不填；原题漏印了空格。

questions.stem:
— Where does the story "Hansel and Gretel" come from?
— It comes from ____ European country.
questions.reason: European 以 /j/ 开头，泛指一个欧洲国家应为 a European country；原句漏印 country 前的空格。

questions.stem: The lady took ________ X-ray and she showed the X-ray to the doctor.
questions.reason: X-ray 的开头发音为 /eks/，泛指一次检查用 an；后面的 the X-ray 特指此次检查。

questions.stem:
— Who is____ boy over there?
— He is Tom. He is hard working and often buys _____useful book to read.
questions.reason: over there 限定那个男孩，填 the；useful 以 /j/ 开头，泛指一本有用的书，用 a。

questions.stem: Bob can play ________ basketball but he can't play ________ violin.
questions.reason: play basketball 不加冠词；play the violin 在乐器前加 the。

questions.stem: My parents take me to have____________ lunch every Sunday.
questions.reason: have lunch 表吃午饭，三餐名称作日常用餐含义时不加冠词。

questions.stem:
— I watched ______ movie called Turning Red last Sunday. How interesting it is!
— Really? I will see it this evening.
questions.reason: 首次提到一部名叫 Turning Red 的电影，movie 是单数且以辅音音素开头，填 a。

questions.stem: It's very comfortable to take ____ high-speed railway called "Fuxing Hao", though it moves at ____ high speed.
questions.reason: 特指名为“复兴号”的高铁，用 the；at high speed 表高速，不加冠词。原句第一处空格漏印。

questions.stem: "I am ________ 18-year-old girl out here living my best life. I'm having a good time," said the post-00 Gu Ailing.
questions.reason: 18 的读音 eighteen 以元音音素开头，故用 an 18-year-old girl。

questions.stem:
— Do you often play _____ piano?
— Yes. I want to be _____ musician like Lang Lang.
questions.reason: 弹钢琴用 play the piano；musician 以辅音音素开头，泛指一位音乐家，用 a。

questions.stem:
— Bob, do you know the Three Gorges Dam on Changjiang River?
— Yes, it is considered to be ________ great man-made wonder.
questions.reason: wonder 此处为可数名词，great 以辅音音素开头，填 a，表示一项伟大的人造奇迹。

questions.stem:
— Congratulations, Mike! You've got the first place in the photo competition.
— Thank you! It is ________ unforgettable day for me.
questions.reason: unforgettable 以元音音素开头，表示难忘的一天，用 an。

questions.stem: Leap is ____ unusual film about the Chinese women's national volleyball team. ____ film is directed by Peter Ho-sun Chan.
questions.reason: unusual 以元音音素开头，首次介绍影片用 an；第二次提到这部影片用 the。原题首处空格漏印。

questions.stem: Boys and girls, put ____ time to good use in the coming three months and you are sure to become ____ honor to those who love you and care for you.
questions.reason: put your time to good use 中 time 表时间，不加冠词；honor 的 h 不发音，become an honor 表成为令人骄傲的人。原题漏印空格。

questions.stem: Boys and girls, please treat this exam with ____ usual mind. Read every sentence carefully and you're sure to get good grades.
questions.reason: usual 的起始音为 /j/，所以泛指一种平常心用 a usual mind；原题空格应在 usual 前。

questions.stem: Locus usually has ________ egg and some milk for breakfast.
questions.reason: egg 以元音音素开头，表示早餐吃一个鸡蛋，用 an。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 02 名词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料有1题因原题歧义或缺少判定依据标为待核对，暂不计分。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: There are some ________ on the hill.
questions.reason: sheep 的单复数同形；some 后需要复数意义，sheeps 不成立，goat 则需改成 goats。

questions.stem: Mr Black often gives us ________ by Email.
questions.reason: information 为不可数名词，不加 -s；some good information 表一些有用的信息。

questions.stem: There are some new books in the school library. They are ____ books.
questions.reason: children 是 child 的不规则复数，其所有格为 children’s，表示儿童读物。

questions.stem: I have worn out my shoes, so I want to buy a new ________ .
questions.reason: shoes 通常成双使用；a new pair 省略了 of shoes，不能用 one 指代一双鞋。

questions.stem: Meimei’s handwriting is better than any other ______ in his class.
questions.reason: 比较的是 Meimei 的书写和其他某个学生的书写，需用 student’s 省略 handwriting；any other 后用单数。

questions.stem: The hospital is a bit far from here. It’s about _______ .
questions.reason: 四十分钟的步行路程用 forty minutes’ walk，复数 minutes 以 s 结尾，只加撇号。

questions.stem: How many _____ are there in your class ?
questions.reason: Japanese 单复数同形，适用于 how many；American、Australian 此处均需复数形式。

questions.stem: I found my black cat in_____ room.
questions.reason: 只有一间两人共有的房间，所有格加在最后一个人名上：Jim and Mike’s room。

questions.stem: How much are the _____ ?
questions.reason: are 要求复数名词；tomato 的复数为 tomatoes，bread 不可数，potatos 拼写错误。

questions.stem: There are many ______ in our school.
questions.reason: woman 作定语修饰复数职业名词时也变复数，故用 women teachers。

questions.stem: Three months ________ a long time for me.
questions.reason: Three months 在此视为一整段时间，整体作单数主语，谓语用 is。

questions.stem:
— Dad, when will you be free? You agreed to go to the seaside with me four days ago.
— I am sorry, Jean. But I think I will have a______________ holiday soon.
questions.reason: 数词加名词作前置复合定语时，名词用单数，four-day 修饰 holiday，不能写成 four-days。

questions.stem: He has searched the ____ for 2 hours for the information about Yang Liwei.
questions.reason: search the Internet 表在互联网上搜索信息；keyboard 是键盘，不是信息检索的平台。

questions.stem: The room is too small. There isn't enough ____ for another desk.
questions.reason: room 此处表示可用空间，是不可数名词；no enough room 意为没有足够空间，原文更规范写法为 not enough room。

questions.stem: Such a wonderful concert is really pleasant for our ____.
questions.reason: concert 是听觉享受，应与 ears 搭配；eyes、mouth 分别表示眼睛、嘴。

questions.stem:
— Which room shall we live in tonight?
— In ____.
questions.reason: 房号通常按 Room + 基数词排列，写成 Room 406，不加 the。

questions.stem: Let the children go away. They're making too much ____ here.
questions.reason: 孩子制造的干扰声是 noise；voice 指嗓音，sound 泛指声音。

questions.stem:
— Where's Tom?
— He's left a _______ saying that he has something to do.
questions.reason: leave a message 表留口信；saying 引出留言内容，news 不与 a 连用。

questions.stem: He has got __________ to tell you.
questions.reason: news 为不可数名词，可用 some news；不能用 a good news，a lot 后也缺 of。

questions.stem: I am too thirsty. I’d like to have _________.
questions.reason: orange 在此指橙汁；four bottles of orange 中数量大于一，量词 bottle 变为 bottles。

questions.stem: It's about _____________ walk from my home to school.
questions.reason: ten minutes’ walk 用时间名词复数的所有格作定语，minutes 后加撇号。

questions.stem:
— Every morning, Mr. Smith takes a __________ to work.
— Walking is good for his health.
questions.reason: take a 20-minute walk 表步行20分钟；复合定语用单数 minute，并用连字符连接。

questions.stem: We usually have a seven _________________ holiday every National Day.
questions.reason: 表示七天的假期，时间名词复数的所有格为 seven days’；规范表达也可直接用 a seven-day holiday。

questions.stem: This is _________________ family photo. I took it on her mother's _________________ birthday.
questions.reason: 家庭照属于 Mary，用 Mary’s；第40个生日用序数词 fortieth。

questions.stem: It's about two _____ walk from the sports center to the town center.
questions.reason: two hours’ walk 表两小时步行路程，hours 为复数，其所有格只在末尾加撇号。

questions.stem: These are ______ books, each of them has one.
questions.reason: each of them has one 说明各自拥有书，分别在两个人名后加 ’s：Jim’s and Tom’s。

questions.stem:
— ____ is that new car over there?
— I think it's ____.
questions.reason: 询问归属应为 Whose is that new car，原题漏 is；Charis 以 s 结尾，其所有格 Charis’ 和 Charis’s 都可接受，B、C 不宜作唯一答案。
questions.examNote: 原句缺is；Charis’和Charis’s均可构成以s结尾的人名所有格，B、C均有依据，暂不计分。

questions.stem:
— You have a nice house! Whose room is this?
— It's ___________.
questions.reason: 问的是一间共有的房间，所有格只加在末尾，填 Jack and Peter’s。

questions.stem: The movie named A Little Red Flower shows __________ love for their children.
questions.reason: 泛指父母们的爱，用复数 parents 的所有格 parents’；parent’s 只表示一位家长的。

questions.stem: Those exchange _______ homes are in the UK.
questions.reason: Those exchange students 为复数，这些学生的家用 students’ homes。

questions.stem:
— It's easy to travel from Urumqi to Lanzhou by taking high— speed railway.
— Yes. It's only________.
questions.reason: eight hours’ ride 表八小时车程；复数 hours 的所有格应在 s 后加撇号。

questions.stem:
— ___________________ does the new book belong to?
— I think it must be ___________________.
questions.reason: belong to 的对象用 who/whom 提问，不能用 whose；第二空表示“Jim的书”，需用 Jim’s。

questions.stem: It's about twenty ____ bus ride from my home to school.
questions.reason: twenty minutes’ bus ride 表20分钟公交车程，minutes 用复数所有格；原句该处空格漏印。

questions.stem: Mr. Smith is a teacher of ____. She and her classmates like him very much.
questions.reason: a teacher of my sister’s 是双重所有格，表示我妹妹的老师中的一位。

questions.stem:
— I think it's ____________room here
— Right. His room is clean and tidy
questions.reason: room 前用人名所有格，答句 His 排除了 Lucy’s，故为 Tom’s room。

questions.stem:
— Jack, Is this notebook yours?
— No, it isn't ________________. I think it's ________________.
questions.reason: 第一空独立作表语用 mine；第二空用 Nick’s 省略 notebook，表示Nick的笔记本。
cup 前用形容词性物主代词 your；第二空无名词用 mine；第三空表示Linda的杯子，用 Linda’s。

questions.stem: These books aren't _______________. They are the _______________.
questions.reason: 第一空位于 aren’t 后，应独立用 mine；第二空为复数 students 的所有格 students’，故选B，原答案D中的 my 不能独立作表语。
questions.examNote: 原答案D改为B：aren’t后须用能独立作表语的mine。

questions.stem: Jim lives in his ____________ house. They like him very much.
questions.reason: 后句 They 指两位祖父母，故用复数 grandparents 的所有格 grandparents’ 修饰 house。

questions.stem:
— Fruit juice can be harmful to ___________ teeth, Cathy.
— OK, I won't let them drink too much.
questions.reason: teeth 属于孩子们，需用复数 kids 的所有格 kids’，并与后句 them 对应。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 03 介词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料有1题因原题歧义或缺少判定依据标为待核对，暂不计分。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: Place names often have interesting connections ________ the local landscape and people.
questions.reason: have connections to 表与……有关联，地名和当地景观、居民存在联系，填 to。

questions.stem: My mother often tells me it's impolite to hit an empty bowl ______ chopsticks.
questions.reason: with chopsticks 表使用筷子这一工具；in、on 不能表达此处的工具关系。

questions.stem:
— Can you tell me something about Dazhou, Lin Hui?
— No problem. It's ___________the northeast of Sichuan Province and it's famous ___________its natural gas.
questions.reason: 达州在四川省内部的东北部，用 in；be famous for natural gas 表因天然气而闻名。

questions.stem: Father's Day comes _______June every year.
questions.reason: June 是月份，表示在六月用 in June，不用 on 或 at。

questions.stem: Please think_______ the question (问题).
questions.reason: think about the question 表思考这个问题，about 引出思考的内容。

questions.stem: We can get a mobile phone_______ our grandpa.
questions.reason: get a mobile phone for our grandpa 表给爷爷买手机，for 引出受益者。

questions.stem:
— What do you usually have ________ breakfast?
— Hainan noodles.
questions.reason: have … for breakfast 表早餐吃……，用 for 说明是哪一餐的食物。

questions.stem: ___________a cold Sunday evening, a thief broke into her house and stole a lot of money.
questions.reason: 具体到某个寒冷的星期日晚上，用 On a cold Sunday evening。

questions.stem:
— Can you tell me the way ________________ the bank?
— Turn left ____________ the second crossing.
questions.reason: the way to the bank 表去银行的路；at the second crossing 表在第二个十字路口。

questions.stem:
— What would you like, sir?
— I'd like a bowl of noodles ____some beef, please.
questions.reason: noodles with some beef 表带牛肉的面条，with 表含有、带有。

questions.stem: The Smiths usually have dinner__7:00 p. m __ the evening.
questions.reason: 7点是具体时刻，用 at；in the evening 泛指在晚上，用 in。

questions.stem: The girl ______ long, straight hair is talking to a teacher ______ a black coat.
questions.reason: with long, straight hair 作定语说明外貌；in a black coat 表穿着黑色外套，均不另加谓语。

questions.stem: The boy ________ me put the ruler ________ himself and his deskmate so that they can share it together.
questions.reason: 男孩在说话者前面，用 in front of；尺子放在自己和同桌两者之间，用 between。

questions.stem: ________traveling around during the holiday, most people choose to rest at home to avoid the crowds.
questions.reason: 句意是以在家休息代替外出旅行，Instead of 后接 traveling；because of 表原因，不合这里的替代关系。

questions.stem:
— What would you like?
— I'd like some dumplings _____________carrots and beef.
questions.reason: dumplings with carrots and beef 表含胡萝卜和牛肉馅的饺子，with 表含有。

questions.stem:
— What do you think of the book?
— _______ my opinion, it is the most popular one among these books.
questions.reason: in my opinion 是固定短语，表示在我看来。

questions.stem:
— Please don't stand at the door. You are_____________ the way.
— Oh, I'm sorry.
questions.reason: in the way 表挡道；on the way 表在途中，不能说明站在门口妨碍通行。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, where is the Science Museum?
— Go ___________ the street. It is on your right.
questions.reason: go across the street 表从街道一边横穿到另一边；through 常指从内部穿过。

questions.stem: I usually get up ________ 6:30 in the morning. And you?
questions.reason: 6:30 为具体时刻，前用介词 at。

questions.stem: 200 families won 2021 Jiangsu Most Beautiful Families Award this year, and 15 families from Taizhou were ________ them.
questions.reason: 15个家庭属于获奖家庭这一多成员群体，填 among；between 此处不用于泛指群体之中。

questions.stem: Our English teacher came into the classroom ________ a smile on her face.
questions.reason: with a smile on her face 表她脸上带着微笑，with 引出伴随状态。

questions.stem: We need to guard ________ any possible danger around us.
questions.reason: guard against danger 为固定搭配，表示防范危险，填 against。

questions.stem: We're glad to see that Shenzhou-14 rose into the sky ________ June 5, 2022.
questions.reason: June 5, 2022 是具体日期，前用 on。

questions.stem:
— Dad, where is Mom?
— Turn back and look ___________ you. Here she comes!
questions.reason: Turn back 提示向身后看，look behind you 表向你的后面看。

questions.stem:
— What would you like, sir?
— I'd like one gongbao chicken and one mapo tofu _______rice.
questions.reason: with rice 表配米饭，说明点菜时的搭配，而非目的或所属。

questions.stem: You're now __________ the other end of the world, but I feel like you're here, smiling.
questions.reason: at the other end of the world 表在世界另一端，at 表端点位置。

questions.stem: I think robots can do what humans can't do ______the control of computers.
questions.reason: under the control of computers 表在计算机控制之下，是固定搭配。

questions.stem: A new bridge _________ the Yangtze River in Nanjing was open to traffic on April 24, 2022.
questions.reason: 桥梁位于江面上方并横跨江面，用 over；through 表内部穿过，along 表沿着。

questions.stem: Each year, our school holds a charity bazaar to raise money ________ the children in poor areas.
questions.reason: raise money for the children 表为孩子们筹款，for 引出受助对象。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, where is the nearest post office?
— Go ________ the road, and then turn right ________ the first turning.
questions.reason: go down the road 表沿路走；at the first turning 表在第一个转弯处。

questions.stem: ________ May 2022, we held many events to celebrate the 100th birthday of the Communist Youth League of China.
questions.reason: May 2022 具体到月份而非某一天，用 In。

questions.stem: My cousin Lisa is going to get married ________ John on New Year's Day. They're both _________ their twenties.
questions.reason: get married to sb 表与某人结婚；in their twenties 表在他们二十多岁时。

questions.stem: Maria went skating with her friends in the park ________ a sunny morning.
questions.reason: 具体到一个晴朗的早晨，用 on a sunny morning，而非泛指早晨的 in the morning。

questions.stem:
— I'm going to Disneyland______ two weeks.
— Wow, sounds like fun！
questions.reason: 现在将来计划中 in two weeks 表两周后，in + 时间段表示从现在起多久以后。

questions.stem: Please go________ the road and the market is on your right.
questions.reason: go along the road 表沿道路向前走，填 along。

questions.stem: I see no light and hear no sound ______ the wind far away.
questions.reason: in the wind 表在风中，the wind far away 指远处的风声。

questions.stem: Our classroom is ________ the teachers' office.
questions.reason: below the teachers’ office 表位于教师办公室下方，是四项中能表达上下位置的一项。

questions.stem: We have lived here ________ 2009 and it has been 13 years so far.
questions.reason: have lived 为现在完成时，2009 是时间起点，用 since；后句13年与持续到现在相呼应。

questions.stem: Jack looked ________ the window and saw Angel watering a tree in the garden.
questions.reason: 下文在花园里浇树要求从窗内向外看，常用 look out of/through the window；原答案C over 不能准确表达此意，原选项缺少通常所需答案，保留待核对。
questions.examNote: 看到窗外花园的语境通常需look out of/through the window；原选项与所给答案不足以唯一确定合理表达。

questions.stem: There is a very big river ________ their school and the village.
questions.reason: between … and … 表在学校与村庄两者之间，结构中的 and 与 between 配对。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 04 数词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料有3题因原题歧义或缺少判定依据标为待核对，暂不计分。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: Lincoln was born on ________.
questions.reason: 英文日期可写“月 + 日 + 年”，具体日期前用 on；February 12, 1809 的顺序正确。

questions.stem: A _______ boy can sing the English song very well.
questions.reason: 前置年龄定语用 ten-year-old，year 用单数并加连字符；A、C 两项完全相同，均成立，不能唯一判分。
questions.examNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（两选项一致）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。
questions.originalExamNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（两选项一致）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。

questions.stem: An hour later, _____ minister was sent to see the “magic cloth” woven by those two men.
questions.reason: the second minister 指继第一位之后的第二位大臣，用序数词并加 the。

questions.stem: Abraham Lincoln was _______ President of the United States.
questions.reason: 表示第16任总统，用序数词 the 16th；16 是基数词，不能直接表示任次。

questions.stem: Do you think there is any room for us ________ ?
questions.reason: us two 表“我们两个人”，基数词 two 作同位语说明 us 的人数，不加 the。

questions.stem: How many students are there in your class? ________.
questions.reason: 45 写作 forty-five；29 应有连字符，32 不加 and，fifties 不能直接回答人数。

questions.stem: Which number is wrong? _______.
questions.reason: 本题选拼写错误的数词，nineteen 不能写成 Ninteen；ninety、ninth、nineteenth 均为正确词形。

questions.stem: The People's Liberation Army was founded _______.
questions.reason: August 1, 1927 和 August 1st, 1927 都是合法日期表达，前面均用 on，因此A、C均可。
questions.examNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确，优先 A）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。
questions.originalExamNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确，优先 A）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。

questions.stem: The number 4,123 is read _______.

options.text: four thousand one hundred and twenty-three
four thousand and one hundred twenty-three
four thousand and a hundred and twenty-three
four thousands a hundred and twenty-three

questions.reason: 4,123 分为 four thousand、one hundred 和 twenty-three；英式读法在 hundred 后加 and，thousand 不加复数 s。

questions.stem: The old professor still works hard though he is _________.
questions.reason: in his sixties 表他六十多岁；“in + 物主代词 + 整十复数”表示年龄段。

questions.stem: This classroom is ________ ours.
questions.reason: 三倍一样大用 three times as big as，倍数应放在 as … as 结构之前。

questions.stem: The basketball team of our school ranks ________ in the match.
questions.reason: rank 作“排名”讲时通常直接接序数词，ranks third 表排名第三，建议B；原答案D含多余的 the，不按其机械作答。
questions.examNote: 按rank表示排名的常用表达改为ranks third；原答案为D。

questions.stem: Which is the car that he drives? It's ________.
questions.reason: the fifty-fourth car 表第54辆车，序数词作前置定语要加 the，且54的序数写作 fifty-fourth。

questions.stem: Which of the following is wrong? ________.

options.text: He is at the age of 15.

questions.reason: 本题要求选错误句；作表语应为 fifteen years old，D把 years 错写为单数，不能与前置 fifteen-year-old 混用。

questions.stem: Our school is not very big. There are only ________ students.
questions.reason: nine hundred 表确切的900，hundred 不加 -s，也不接 of；hundreds of 用于不确切的大量。

questions.stem: How many new words are there in ________ lesson? There are only _________.
questions.reason: 第5课用 the fifth lesson；回答单词数量用基数词 five，不加 the。

questions.stem: ________, Coca-Cola began to enter China's market.
questions.reason: 表示20世纪70年代，用 in the 1970s，年代前有 the，1970s 后无所属撇号。

questions.stem: There was no bus in that small town. We had a ________.
questions.reason: 作 walk 的前置定语，用 ten-mile，mile 为单数；ten miles’ walk 则是另一种所有格结构。

questions.stem: Today is the first day and ________.
questions.reason: the fourth 省略 day，表示第4天；选项B句法完整，其他项缺少正确的序数或搭配。题干未说明首日星期，日期对应仍需语境。

questions.stem: Which room do you live in? ________.
questions.reason: 房号采用 Room + 基数词，Room 201；不能把201改成序数词。

questions.stem: How many magazines do you have? I have ________.
questions.reason: How many 询问数量，用基数词 two；twice 表次数，the second 表次序。

questions.stem: Three hundred thousand one hundred and seventy means ________.
questions.reason: three hundred thousand 为300000，one hundred and seventy 为170，合并即300170。

questions.stem: On May ________, ________ people traveled round the country.
questions.reason: May the first 为5月1日；不确指人数时用 millions of，million 既加 -s 又接 of。

questions.stem: ________ of them are dining at school.
questions.reason: Twelve of them 表其中12人，基数词直接接 of；twelfth 指第12个，意义不同。
时刻7:17可顺读为 seven seventeen，小时和分钟分别读出，不用 and。

questions.stem: Four ________ two is two.
questions.reason: 4−2=2，减法用 minus，故填 minus。

questions.stem: Three ________ five is eight.
questions.reason: 3+5=8，加法用 plus，故填 plus。

questions.stem: Three ________ seven is twenty-one.
questions.reason: 3×7=21，乘法用 times，故填 times。

questions.stem: Forty-two ________ seven is six.
questions.reason: 42÷7=6，除法用 divided by，故填 divided by。

questions.stem: There are ____ days in an ordinary year.
questions.reason: 365的英式读法是 three hundred and sixty-five，美式也可省 and；B、D均属合法读法，不能仅因D无and判错。普通年365天，闰年366天。
questions.examNote: B为英式数词读法，D为常见美式读法，两者均成立；原答案仅列B，暂不唯一计分。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 05 代词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: I have ________ but praise for the police because they often help people out of trouble. Yes, they’re well worth praising.
questions.reason: nothing but praise 表除了赞扬没有别的，即只有赞扬；与后句 well worth praising 呼应。

questions.stem: These are my cousins. ________ are both university students.
questions.reason: my cousins 是复数第三人称，作主语用 They，并与 are both 对应。

questions.stem: You never give up in difficult situations. I believe ________ is impossible to a hopeful heart.
questions.reason: 对怀有希望的人没有什么是不可能的，用 nothing 构成 nothing is impossible。

questions.stem: My sister is only six, but ________ can already help with some housework.
questions.reason: my sister 指女性单数，主格代词用 she，与 can help 连用。

questions.stem: As the art festival is coming, they are preparing everything by ________.
questions.reason: by themselves 表他们自己独立完成，反身代词需与主语 they 一致。

questions.stem: These are my cousins. ________ are both university students.
questions.reason: my cousins 指多位表兄弟姐妹，后句主语用 They，不能用单数 I。

questions.stem: These are my cousins. ________ are both university students.
questions.reason: These are my cousins 已说明第三人称复数，后句选 They 与 are both 对应。

questions.stem: The three heroes returned to the earth from space. We are proud of ________.
questions.reason: of 为介词，后接宾格；the three heroes 是复数，故用 them。

questions.stem: Is this your Bing Dwen Dwen (冰墩墩)? No. ________ is on the sofa.
questions.reason: Mine 相当于 my Bing Dwen Dwen，独立作主语，表示我的冰墩墩在沙发上。

questions.stem: There are two apples on the table. One is red and ________ is green.
questions.reason: 已限定两个苹果，用 one … the other … 表示一个……另一个……。

questions.stem: The mother encourages her little son to learn to look after ________ .
questions.reason: son 是男性单数，look after himself 表自己照顾自己，反身代词与 son 对应。

questions.stem: I always believe that there isn’t ______ difficult if we set our mind to do it.
questions.reason: isn’t 构成否定句，后用 anything；difficult 后置修饰 anything，表示没有任何困难的事。

questions.stem: Dad, I’m afraid I can’t do well in my math test tomorrow. Don’t worry. Believe in ________.
questions.reason: believe in yourself 表相信你自己，父亲鼓励听话的孩子，应使用第二人称反身代词。

questions.stem: I began to teach ________ English when I was twenty-two years old.
questions.reason: teach sb English 的 sb 作宾语，指他们用宾格 them。

questions.stem: The Internet makes _________ lives easier, but it sometimes brings trouble to __________ students.
questions.reason: lives 前需形容词性物主代词 our；to 是介词，后接宾格 us，us students 表我们学生。

questions.stem:
What’s the matter with my throat, doctor?
— ______. Drinking more hot water is OK.
questions.reason: 答句说喝点热水就好，应为 Nothing serious；形容词 serious 后置修饰不定代词。

questions.stem: To keep ________ safe, you’d better not go out alone at night.
questions.reason: 主句说 you’d better，keep yourself safe 表保证你自己的安全，填 yourself。

questions.stem: Where is your brother? I want to give ________ a book.
questions.reason: brother 为男性单数，give him a book 中 him 作 give 的间接宾语。

questions.stem:
I need ________ school things.
— Me, too. Let’s go shopping.
questions.reason: 肯定句说需要一些学习用品，用 some；no 与购物需求矛盾，any 通常用于疑问或否定句。

questions.stem:
How can we go to the library this Sunday, by bike or on foot?
— ________ is OK. It’s up to you.
questions.reason: 两种出行方式任选一种都可，用 Either 与单数 is 搭配；both 作主语通常接 are。

questions.stem:
Thank you for sharing the cake with ________.
— It’s ________ pleasure.
questions.reason: with 后接宾格 me；pleasure 前接形容词性物主代词 my，构成 It’s my pleasure。

questions.stem:
Why are you so excited?
— The scientist Huang Xuhua will come to our school. I can’t wait to see _________.
questions.reason: Huang Xuhua 为男性单数，see 后用宾格 him，不用复数 them。

questions.stem: This isn’t my schoolbag. ________ is over there.
questions.reason: Mine 代替 my schoolbag，与前句 my schoolbag 对应，独立作主语。

questions.stem:
Why are you laughing, Tony?
— There is ________ funny in the magazine.
questions.reason: 笑的原因是杂志里有有趣的内容，肯定句用 something，funny 后置修饰。

questions.stem:
Is the girl in a red skirt your sister?
— Yes. ________ favorite color is red.
questions.reason: favorite color 前需形容词性物主代词；指女孩的颜色，用 Her。

questions.stem: Another three astronauts, Liu Yang, Chen Dong and Cai Xuzhe, have been sent into space. Let’s express (表达) our best wishes to ________ .
questions.reason: to 后用宾格；三位宇航员为复数，用 them 指代。

questions.stem:
To go abroad or not to go after graduation, it’s a question.
— You may take ________ of the roads. But being home in the end matters.
questions.reason: two roads 表两种选择，可任选一条，用 either；none 通常用于三者或以上。

questions.stem: Miss Li is our physics teacher. She teaches ________ P.E. as well.
questions.reason: teach sb P.E. 中 sb 作宾语，指我们用 us，our 不能独立作人称宾语。

questions.stem:
Hurry up, or we will miss the school bus.
— Don’t worry. We have ________ time.
questions.reason: time 不可数，a little 表还有一点时间，与 Don’t worry 呼应；little 表几乎没有。

questions.stem: Even if we are in Grade 9, it’s necessary for _______ to go to bed early and get up early.
questions.reason: for 后用人称代词宾格，it’s necessary for us to do 表做某事对我们有必要。

questions.stem: Mary has a brother, and ________ name is Bob.
questions.reason: Bob 是 Mary 的兄弟，男性的姓名用 his name。

questions.stem: Our English teacher, Miss Li, is kind and patient. We all like ________.
questions.reason: like 是动词，宾语指 Miss Li，用宾格 her；hers 表她的某物。

questions.stem: There isn’t ________ in the classroom. All the students are having a PE lesson in the playground.
questions.reason: 学生都在操场，教室里没有任何人，否定句 isn’t 后用 anybody，避免 isn’t nobody 双重否定。

questions.stem:
Coffee or tea, Frank?
— Coffee, please. To get relaxed, ________ is better than a cup of coffee.
questions.reason: nothing is better than … 表没有什么比……更好，即咖啡最能让说话者放松。

questions.stem: ________ is our duty to make our country better and stronger.
questions.reason: It 作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的 to make our country better and stronger。

questions.stem: The living conditions of the endangered wild animals have greatly improved. The number of _______ is rapidly increasing.
questions.reason: the number of them 指这些濒危野生动物的数量，of 后用复数宾格 them。

questions.stem: Learning is a life-long journey, for it brings us ________ new every day.
questions.reason: 肯定句说学习每天带来一些新东西，用 something，new 应放在其后。

questions.stem: Students should learn some living skills to take good care of ________.
questions.reason: Students 是复数，照顾的是学生自己，用 take good care of themselves。

questions.stem: We took pride in _________ when we succeeded in reaching the top of the mountain finally.
questions.reason: 主语 We 与介词后的对象同指我们自己，用 ourselves，表示为自己登顶而自豪。

questions.stem: These two boys enjoy reading. They are talking about________favorite writers.
questions.reason: favorite writers 前需要形容词性物主代词 their；theirs 为名词性，不能直接修饰 writers。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 06 形容词/副词
