source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem:
Why do you hardly make mistakes?
— Because I do everything very _______.
questions.reason: 很少犯错的原因是做事认真，填 carefully 修饰 do；carelessly 表粗心，与语境相反。

questions.stem:
Is your toothache getting _______?
— No, it’s even worse.
questions.reason: 答句 No, it’s even worse 否认有所好转，问句应是 getting better。

questions.stem: Although he is _______, he plays basketball very well.
questions.reason: Although 表让步，个子矮却篮球打得好形成反差，选 short。

questions.stem: If you want to borrow books from the school library, ________ forget your ID card.
questions.reason: 借书需要身份证件，never forget 表千万不要忘；hardly forget 只是几乎不忘，不能表达此处提醒。

questions.stem: It’s ________ to look up the new words in the dictionary when you meet them.
questions.reason: 遇到生词查字典有必要，用 necessary；polite、lively、safe 不对应查词的必要性。

questions.stem: China is becoming stronger and we’re all ________ our country.
questions.reason: be proud of our country 表为祖国自豪，与国家越来越强大呼应。

questions.stem: Zhao Chen ran ________ of all the students at the sports meeting.
questions.reason: of all the students 给出全体比较范围，跑得最快用副词最高级 fastest。

questions.stem: Although Lingling studies online at home, she studies ________ than before.
questions.reason: than before 是比较标志，努力程度更高用 harder，不用最高级。

questions.stem: Most people don’t like eating lemons because they taste ________.
questions.reason: 柠檬尝起来酸，taste 后接形容词 sour 作表语。

questions.stem: Jenny is going to buy a pair of glasses because she can ________ see things clearly these days.
questions.reason: 买眼镜是因为几乎看不清，hardly 表几乎不，与 can see 搭配形成否定含义。

questions.stem:
What place will you suggest if I travel to your hometown?
— The best-known Mount Huangshan comes _______ as the first choice.
questions.reason: 黄山最负盛名，自然成为首选，用 naturally 修饰 comes；hardly 则是否定。

questions.stem:
Jim and I share ____ tastes and hobbies.
— No wonder you take part in lots of meaningful social activities together.
questions.reason: 一起参加许多活动说明品味和爱好相似，填 similar。

questions.stem:
How’s the new restaurant?
— It’s ________. We waited a long time for the food to arrive.
questions.reason: 上菜等很久说明体验糟糕，填 awful，而不是 wonderful 或 exciting。

questions.stem: Linda spoke too quietly. I could ________ hear her at the back.
questions.reason: 说话声音太小，后排几乎听不到，用 hardly；always、usually 意思相反。

questions.stem:
Everything he does is ________ to what is considered normal.
— Although he looks a little different, he has achieved a lot in the math field.
questions.reason: 与“正常”相反却在数学上有成就，用 opposite，be opposite to 表与……相反。

questions.stem: The air in Huaihua is _______ than before.
questions.reason: than before 要求比较级，good 的比较级是 better。

questions.stem: With the development of 5G technology, our daily lives have become _______.
questions.reason: 表达越来越便利，用 more and more convenient；convenient 的比较级不用 -er。

questions.stem: Amy did very well in her report. She is ________ to pay attention to every detail.
questions.reason: enough 修饰形容词时后置，careful enough to do 表足够细心，能注意每个细节。

questions.stem: Yesterday, Lin Tao’s speech on how to be a good volunteer was ________ wonderful that we couldn’t stop cheering for him.
questions.reason: so + 形容词 + that 从句表如此……以至于，wonderful 前用 so。

questions.stem: It’s ________ of the boy to leave the tap running.
questions.reason: 让水龙头一直开着体现粗心，用 careless；of the boy 对人的行为品质作评价。

questions.stem:
Who do you think will win the race, Bob or Tom?
— It must be Bob. I think he runs ________.
questions.reason: 比较Bob和Tom两人，用比较级；认为Bob会赢，说明跑得更快，填 faster。

questions.stem: I only got four hours of sleep last night, so I feel ________ today.
questions.reason: 只睡四小时会感到疲倦，选 tired，与 lonely、hungry 的含义无关。

questions.stem: The 21.58-meter-long 3D-printed bridge in Chengdu, with its _______ part reaching 8 meters and highest point hitting 2.68 meters, is really amazing.
questions.reason: 桥长已给21.58米、高给2.68米，另一个8米尺寸应指最宽处，填 widest。

questions.stem:
What is___________ river in China?
— The Yangtze River. It's about 6,300 kilometers long.
questions.reason: in China 给出国内全部河流的比较范围，6300公里提示最长，用 the longest。

questions.stem: Good luck belongs to hard-working people. ________ you work, the luckier you will be.
questions.reason: the + 比较级，the + 比较级 表越……越……，努力工作对应 The harder。

questions.stem: Although he failed many times, he ________ gave up his dream.
questions.reason: Although failed many times 表虽多次失败却不放弃，填 never。

questions.stem: Travelling by train is slower than by plane. But it’s ________ than by plane.
questions.reason: than 要求比较级；But 引出坐火车虽慢却更有趣的优点，按此语境选 more interesting。

questions.stem: On a ________ day, you can see most of the city from the top of the tower.
questions.reason: 能从塔顶看清大部分城市需要晴朗天气，clear day 表晴天。

questions.stem: Cindy felt ________ in her new school, so she joined some clubs to make new friends.
questions.reason: 为结交新朋友而加入社团，说明之前在新学校感到孤单，用 lonely。

questions.stem: Photos speak ________, but they say a lot about our lives.
questions.reason: 照片不发声却能传递丰富内容，silently 表无声地，符合后半句转折。

questions.stem:
When I get home, it makes me feel comfortable to find everything in apple-pie order.
句中“in apple-pie order”的意思最接近哪一项？
questions.reason: in apple-pie order 表整整齐齐，等同于 tidy；不是指食物香脆的 crispy。

questions.stem: The earlier we take action to protect our environment, the ________ it will be for our future.
questions.reason: The earlier …, the better … 表越早行动，对未来越好，两空均体现比较关系。

questions.stem: There was a storm yesterday. ________, most of the flowers in my garden are still alive.
questions.reason: 风暴后多数花仍然活着是一件幸运的事，用 Luckily 修饰后面整件事。

questions.stem: Everybody, please keep ________. It’s not allowed to make any noise in the reading room.
questions.reason: 后句禁止发出声音，keep quiet 表保持安静；quiet 为形容词作表语。

questions.stem: Roy is a great dancer. He dances ________ than others.
questions.reason: 修饰 dances 用副词，than others 要求比较级 more beautifully；great dancer 排除 less beautifully。

questions.stem: The Yangtze River is one of ________ rivers in the world.
questions.reason: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词表示最……的之一，故用 the longest rivers。

questions.stem: If you want to go to university, you should take your schoolwork ________ .
questions.reason: take … seriously 是固定搭配，表示认真对待学业；seriously 修饰 take。

questions.stem: We are _______ that the Great Wall is one of the wonders of the world.
questions.reason: 长城是世界奇迹之一让人自豪，be proud that … 表为……感到自豪。

questions.stem: On April 16th, astronauts Zhai Zhigang, Wang Yaping and Ye Guangfu ______ came back to Earth from the Tiangong space station.
questions.reason: 形容宇航员返回地球的安全状态，用 safely 修饰 came back。

questions.stem:
Jessica, it’s raining ________ outside.
— Oh, you should be ________ when you drive to work.
questions.reason: rain hard 表雨下得大，hardly 表几乎不；be careful 中 careful 作表语，不用 carefully。

questions.stem:
Did you see the football match yesterday?
— Yes! I think it is the ________ game that I have ever seen.
questions.reason: that I have ever seen 限定以往看过的所有比赛，用最高级 most exciting。

questions.stem: The little boy is ________ angry with his parents because he thinks they love his sister more.
questions.reason: 男孩认为父母更爱妹妹，因而经常生气，填 often；never、seldom 与这种抱怨不符。

questions.stem: With a high-speed train station built in Luzhou, it is much ________ for us to travel to Chengdu.
questions.reason: it is … for us 中用形容词作表语；much 修饰比较级 easier，easy 不写 easilier。

questions.stem:
What’s the ________ river in China?
— The Yangtze River.
questions.reason: in China 表国内全部河流的比较范围，需最高级 longest；the 已在题干中给出。

questions.stem: Our school life has become ________ than before because of all kinds of after-school activities.
questions.reason: has become 后需形容词作表语；than before 要求比较级 more colorful。

questions.stem:
Would you like some coffee?
— No, thanks. I ________ drink it. I think water is the best.
questions.reason: 拒绝咖啡并认为水最好，说明几乎不喝咖啡，填 hardly。

questions.stem: _______ cultures such as Chinese knot, Chinese paper-cutting and Chinese opera are deeply loved by students.
questions.reason: 中国结、剪纸、京剧属于传统文化，填 Traditional；不是现代文化 Modern。

questions.stem: David often forgets things. His memory is ______.
questions.reason: 经常忘事说明记忆力差，poor memory 表记性差。

questions.stem:
Will you go to the museum by bus?
— I'd rather take a taxi. It's ______.
questions.reason: 在公交与出租车之间选择后者，按赶路语境说明更快，比较级用 faster。

questions.stem:
I hear your parents have moved to the village.
— Yes. The countryside is more ________ than before.
questions.reason: 同意搬到乡村并肯定变化，说明乡村比过去更舒适，more comfortable 符合语意。

questions.stem: Oh, she smiles! She nods! She understands! We’ve got ________ dog in the world.
questions.reason: in the world 表全世界范围，且狗会点头、听懂话，填 the cleverest，而非害羞的 shyest。

questions.stem:
Cindy, can I look at your notebook? It looks special.
— Sorry. I usually write down something ________ in it.
questions.reason: 不愿给别人看笔记本，因为记了私人内容，something private 表私密的事情。

questions.stem:
China won third place in the men’s 100-meter relay race at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
— Wonderful! We ________ Su Bingtian and his teammates.
questions.reason: 取得奥运会第三名让人自豪，be proud of 对应此处对运动员的赞许。

questions.stem: As soon as the national hero came into the hall, everyone became ________ and stood up to welcome him.
questions.reason: 英雄到场时大家起身欢迎，体现高兴振奋，用 cheerful。

questions.stem:
Our class did well in the school singing competition.
— Yes, you sang ________ of all.
questions.reason: of all 给出最高级比较范围；修饰 sang 用副词最高级 most beautifully。

questions.stem: Andy doesn’t like junk food at all, so she ________ eats it.
questions.reason: doesn’t like … at all 表完全不喜欢垃圾食品，因此从不吃，填 never。

questions.stem:
Which do you like____________, Chinese or English?
— Chinese.
questions.reason: Chinese 和 English 为两者比较，like … better 表更喜欢，不用最高级 best。

questions.stem: 5G technology has entered everyone’s life. It will be ______ used soon.
questions.reason: 表示5G被广泛应用，widely 修饰 used；hardly 为几乎不，与语境相反。

questions.stem:
Have you heard Shenzhou XIV manned spacecraft (载人飞船) was sent up successfully?
— Wow, that sounds ______ . How great our country is!
questions.reason: 飞船成功发射是令人激动的消息，sounds 后用形容词 exciting 作表语。

questions.stem:
Lucy, I’m poor in English. Could you give me some advice?
— You can speak it as ________ as possible.
questions.reason: as … as possible 中间用原级，speak it as much as possible 表尽量多说英语。

questions.stem:
Mum, I can’t take care of Mary. She is crying all the time.
— Try to be ________, Jack. Your little sister is ill.
questions.reason: 妹妹生病一直哭，要哥哥耐心些，patient 表耐心，符合照顾病人的语境。

questions.stem: ________ you are, ________ mistakes you will make in the exam.
questions.reason: 第一空作 are 的表语，用形容词 careful 的比较级；mistakes 可数，用 fewer，构成越细心错误越少。

questions.stem: Mr. Liu checked his papers__________, so he passed the exam again.
questions.reason: 认真检查试卷帮助通过考试，carefully 修饰 checked；carelessly 表粗心，与结果不符。

questions.stem: The specials in the restaurant taste ________ and sell ________. Many customers come here on weekends.
questions.reason: taste 为系动词，后接形容词 good；sell 为实义动词，用副词 well 修饰，表示畅销。

questions.stem: I ______ go to the art museum because I like painting.
questions.reason: 喜欢绘画，所以经常去美术馆，频率副词用 often。

questions.stem: What a ______ day! Why not go for a picnic?
questions.reason: 建议去野餐需要晴朗天气，sunny day 符合语境；rainy、snowy 不合。

questions.stem: I think swimming is one of _______ sports in our school．
questions.reason: one of 后接 the + 最高级 + 复数名词，故为 the most popular sports。

questions.stem:
Did you see that programme about the talent show on TV last night?
— No, I’m not ________ interested in it.
questions.reason: not really interested 表不怎么感兴趣；hardly 已有否定含义，不能再与 not 搭配表达此意。

questions.stem:
Luckily, Tom helped us solve the problem.
— Great! He is so smart that he can always come up with ________ ideas.
questions.reason: smart 与能解决问题提示聪明的主意，bright ideas 表好点子、聪明的想法。

questions.stem: Jimmy finished the speech ________, and everyone stood up and cheered.
questions.reason: 大家起立欢呼说明演讲完成得成功，用 successfully 修饰 finished。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 07 情态动词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem:
— _________ I take photos here?
— Sorry, you can’t. It’s not allowed in the museum.
questions.reason: Can I …? 用于请求许可；答句 can’t 和 not allowed 表不准拍照，与 Can 对应。

questions.stem: You ________ drive without a license!
questions.reason: without a license 表无证，题意为禁止无证驾驶，用 mustn’t，不是表不必的 needn’t。

questions.stem:
Can you play the guitar, Mark?
— Yes, I ________.
questions.reason: Can you …? 问是否会弹吉他，肯定简答沿用 can：Yes, I can。

questions.stem:
________ you tell us a story in English?
— I think I can do it. Let me try.
questions.reason: 答句 I think I can do it 表有能力做，问句用 Can you …? 请求用英语讲故事。

questions.stem: As we know, sixteen-year-olds ________ drive a car in our country.
questions.reason: 本题语境设定不允许16岁青少年驾驶，用 mustn’t 表禁止；couldn’t 是过去不能。

questions.stem: Students ________ play with fire in the classroom. It’s quite dangerous.
questions.reason: quite dangerous 说明玩火应被禁止，用 mustn’t，而不是只表过去能力的 couldn’t。

questions.stem: When our parents become too old to take care of themselves one day, they __________ be looked after well by us.
questions.reason: 父母年老时我们应照顾他们，should 表应尽的责任，后接被动结构 be looked after。

questions.stem: The boy ________ be Tom. I saw him reading in the library just now.
questions.reason: 刚看到Tom在图书馆，故这里的男孩不可能是他，用 can’t be 表否定推断。

questions.stem:
Do I have to hand in my report now?
— Of course, you ________. We’re going to discuss it.
questions.reason: 马上要讨论报告，因此现在必须交，用 must 表必要性；mustn’t 则是禁止。

questions.stem:
Do you like poems?
— Yes. I ________ read poems when I was 5.
questions.reason: when I was 5 指过去的能力，用 could，不能用现在时 can。

questions.stem:
Listen! I think it ________ be Mrs. Li singing in the next room.
— It ________ be her. I know she has already left for New York.
questions.reason: 第一空听见歌声作肯定推断，用 must；第二空已知她去纽约，否定此推断用 can’t。

questions.stem:
Whose is this toy truck?
— It _________ belong to Dick. He was the only little kid at the picnic.
questions.reason: 野餐时Dick是唯一的小孩，玩具卡车一定属于他，用 must 表有根据的肯定推测。

questions.stem:
What kind of music do you like?
— I like music that I ________ dance to.
questions.reason: can dance to 表能跟着音乐跳舞，can 表能力；must 则强加必须的意思。

questions.stem:
Mike, I can’t stop playing computer games.
— For your eyes, my dear friend, I’m afraid you ________ .
questions.reason: 为保护眼睛而不得不停下游戏，用 have to，后省略 stop playing computer games。

questions.stem: The clever boy ________ recite so many poems when he was three.
questions.reason: when he was three 表过去，能够背诗用 could，表示过去具备的能力。

questions.stem:
Whose English book is this?
— It _______ be Lily’s, but I’m not sure.
questions.reason: but I’m not sure 表不确定，might be Lily’s 意为可能是莉莉的，不能用确定性强的 must。

questions.stem:
Look! Mark is reading a book in the library.
— It ________ be him. He is in the classroom.
questions.reason: 已知Mark在教室，所以图书馆那个人不可能是他，选 can’t。

questions.stem: We should learn some basic life skills since we ________ depend on ourselves some day.
questions.reason: 学习生活技能是因为将来必须依靠自己，用 must；mustn’t 表禁止，语意相反。

questions.stem:
All of us ________ follow the traffic rules when going out.
— Exactly! Safety comes first.
questions.reason: Safety comes first 提示遵守交通规则是必须做的，填 must。

questions.stem:
Can we play games here?
— Better not. If you ________, please go to the open space there.
questions.reason: If you must 表如果你非要这样做不可，must 在此表示坚持做某事，并非一般能力。

questions.stem: Protect your hearing. Don’t wait until you ________ hear a thing.
questions.reason: 提醒保护听力，不要等到听不见任何声音，用 can’t 表丧失听觉能力。

questions.stem:
I don’t care what Kate thinks.
— Well, you _______. Her suggestions are of some value.
questions.reason: Kate的建议有价值，所以你应该在意，should 后省略 care what Kate thinks。

questions.stem: To achieve our dream, we ________ rest on what we have done.
questions.reason: rest on what we have done 表满足于已有成就；为实现梦想，我们不应止步于此，填 should not。

questions.stem:
The paper cutting is pretty lively, who made it?
— It ________ be Amy. None of us except her is able to do it.
questions.reason: 只有Amy能做这种剪纸，因而一定是她做的，用 must 表肯定推断。

questions.stem:
Dad, must I become a doctor like you when I finish university in the future?
— No, you________. You can make your own decision and do whatever you like.
questions.reason: Must I …? 的否定答语用 don’t have to 或 needn’t，表示不必；mustn’t 意为不许。

questions.stem:
I can’t find my dictionary. _______I use yours?
— Sure, here you are.
questions.reason: May I use yours? 礼貌征求许可；答句 Sure, here you are 表示同意。

questions.stem:
Mum, I’ve signed for the box. What’s in it?
— I’m not sure. It ________ be a present from your uncle.
questions.reason: I’m not sure 提示可能性推断，may be a present 表可能是礼物，不用肯定的 must。

questions.stem:
You________ be excited—you have tickets for your favourite band!
— Yes. It’s unbelievable that I can see the band play live!
questions.reason: 拿到最喜欢乐队的门票，可以推断你一定很兴奋，用 must be。

questions.stem:
There is a new art museum in our city. You _______ miss it.
— Thank you. I won’t.
questions.reason: You can’t miss it 在推荐场所时表示你可不能错过；needn’t miss 则不是此处惯用的推荐表达。

questions.stem:
Who is playing the piano in the music room? Is it Mary?
— No, it ________ be her. She has ________ to Beijing on business.
questions.reason: 她去北京尚未回来，所以不可能在弹琴，用 can’t be；has gone to 表去了未归，has been to 表去过已回。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 08 非谓语动词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: ________ the people locked inside, the firemen broke down the door.
questions.reason: 消防员破门是为了接近被困人员，句首 To reach 作目的状语；不能用谓语原形 Reach 直接连接主句。

questions.stem: The local government advises people ___________to other places ___________it is not necessary during the pandemic.
questions.reason: advise sb not to do 表建议不做某事；if it is not necessary 表如果没有必要，不能用 unless 再反转条件。

questions.stem: Mr. Brown told his son not __________ the paintings in the museum.
questions.reason: tell sb not to do 表告诉某人不要做，not 已给，空中应为 to touch。

questions.stem: As teenagers, we are not allowed_____________ mobile phones into school so that we can focus on our schoolwork.
questions.reason: be allowed to do 表被允许做；其否定 not allowed to bring 表不准带手机进学校。

questions.stem: Teenagers often listen to pop music _________.
questions.reason: 听流行音乐的目的是放松，to relax 为不定式目的状语。

questions.stem: Our teacher often tells us _________ across the road when the traffic light is red.
questions.reason: tell sb not to do 表告诉某人不要做某事，not to go 表红灯时不要过马路。

questions.stem: Nancy didn't know anyone in the new school, so she decided to join an after-school club____________ some new friends.
questions.reason: 加入课后社团是为了认识新朋友，to meet 表目的，不作新的谓语。

questions.stem:
— Miss Li, can you tell me how to improve my writing skills?
— Certainly. I advise you ________ a diary in English every day.
questions.reason: advise sb to do 表建议某人做某事，故为 advise you to keep a diary。

questions.stem: Boys and girls, good luck and wish you ________ good grades on your new journey!
questions.reason: wish sb to do 表希望某人做，取得好成绩用 get good grades，填 to get。

questions.stem: Because of COVID-19, the government advised us ____ to the public places less.
questions.reason: 按句末 less 理解为少去公共场所，应为 advise us to go … less，填B；原句漏空格，若填原答案 not to go 又接 less，会产生语意冲突。
questions.examNote: 原答案C改B：保留原句less时应为advise us to go … less；not to go … less与少去的意思冲突。

questions.stem:
— Do you always get up so early?
— Yes, _________ the first bus. My home is far away from school.
questions.reason: 回答起早的原因，用 To catch the first bus 表为了赶首班车。

questions.stem:
— How can I improve my pronunciation, Madam?
— Keep on ______ and you'll make progress.
questions.reason: keep on doing 表持续做某事，on 为介词，practice 需用 practicing。

questions.stem:
— My grandma is used to ______ in the countryside.
— Oh. So is my grandma.
questions.reason: be used to doing 表习惯做，to 是介词，后接 living，不是不定式 live。

questions.stem: My parents are used to ________ after supper.
questions.reason: are used to 表已习惯，后接 walking；表示习惯晚饭后散步。

questions.stem: Mario and his friends are making some plans ______in an old people's home this summer.
questions.reason: make plans to do 表计划做某事，to work 说明在养老院工作的计划。

questions.stem:
— English is difficult ________ at the beginning.
— Yes, but if you keep ________ , you can make progress.
questions.reason: English is difficult to learn 用主动形式的不定式表达被学习的含义；keep doing 后接 trying。

questions.stem: Our school has held many activities ____ the 100th birthday of the Communist Party of China.
questions.reason: 举办活动是为了庆祝，to celebrate 作目的状语，不用过去式 celebrated。

questions.stem: The earth is in great danger now. We have to do something _______ it.
questions.reason: do something to protect it 表采取行动以保护地球，to protect 说明目的。

questions.stem: It's necessary for students __________ eye exercises.
questions.reason: It’s necessary for sb to do 为固定结构，to do eye exercises 是真正的主语。

questions.stem:
— So far, Hi Mom is one of the most ______________films I've ever seen.
— That's true. It is well worth __________again.
questions.reason: 电影令人感动，用 moving 修饰 films；be worth doing 表值得做，后接 seeing。

questions.stem: The teacher with curly hair teaches us _____________ the guitar.
questions.reason: teach sb to do 表教某人做，弹吉他用 play the guitar，故为 to play。

questions.stem: I was deeply moved by the film, Hi, Mum. I think it's well worth _____________.
questions.reason: be well worth doing 表非常值得做，填 watching，不用 to watch。

questions.stem: The film Hi, Mom (《你好, 李焕英》) is moving, and I think it is well worth __________.
questions.reason: worth 后接动名词，well worth seeing 表非常值得看，形式主动而含被动意义。

questions.stem: The government asks people ____ the rubbish from their daily life in different groups.
questions.reason: ask sb to do 表要求某人做，故为 asks people to put the rubbish；原题空格漏印。

questions.stem: I would be interested to see the pandas in the Wolong Panda Reserve, because it allows people __________ closer to them.
questions.reason: allow sb to do 表允许某人做，填 to get，get closer 表靠近。

questions.stem: Last September, Thunderstorm was shown ______Cao Yu, one of China's greatest playwrights.
questions.reason: 演出《雷雨》的目的是纪念曹禺，用 to remember 作目的状语。

questions.stem: Peter's mother gets up early ____________ breakfast for him every morning.
questions.reason: 妈妈早起是为了给Peter做早饭，to make 作目的状语。

questions.stem: It is hard for people to move forward with a strong wind ___________hard.
questions.reason: with + 名词 + 现在分词 表伴随情况；wind 与 blow 为主动关系，故为 a strong wind blowing hard。

questions.stem: When I was young, my parents taught me ________ older people kindly.
questions.reason: teach sb to do 表教某人做某事，填 to treat，表示善待老人。

questions.stem: The villagers plan ____ a new bridge over the river.
questions.reason: plan to do 表计划做某事，填 to build；原题在 plan 后漏印空格。

questions.stem:
— Ms. Griffin, what should we do ____ stupid mistakes in the coming exams?
— Be more careful.
questions.reason: 问为了避免错误该做什么，to avoid 作目的状语；avoid 后接动名词 making，两处形式都要正确。

questions.stem: Mr. White invited me ________ the hill with him last weekend.
questions.reason: invite sb to do 表邀请某人做某事，填 to climb。

questions.stem: Don't worry. We will meet next Monday _______ the project again.
questions.reason: 下周见面是为了再次讨论项目，to discuss 作目的状语。

questions.stem:
— Hi! Alice, why are you in such a hurry?
— ____________ my best friend from Canada at the airport.
questions.reason: 回答为何匆忙，用 To meet … 表为了接从加拿大来的好友，省略了主句。

questions.stem: __________ the online shopping, my grandma bought a smart phone.
questions.reason: 买智能手机是为了享受网购，句首 To enjoy 作目的状语。

questions.stem: During the 16th century, Europe saw rich developments in science, medicine and the arts. People had to "invent" words ________ new ideas.
questions.reason: 创造新词是为了表达新想法，to express 作目的状语，不用三单 expresses。

questions.stem: Remember to use sunglasses to stop the sun from ________ directly in your eyes.
questions.reason: stop … from doing 表阻止……做某事，from 后的 shine 需变为 shining。

questions.stem:
— The movie The Wandering Earth is wonderful. Do you feel like ________it tonight?
— I'd love to, but my parents won't let me _________out too late.
questions.reason: feel like doing 表想做，填 watching；let sb do 为省 to 的不定式，填 stay。

questions.stem: He felt tired, so he stopped _____________ a rest under the tree.
questions.reason: 因疲倦而停下原活动去休息，stop to have a rest；stop having a rest 则是停止休息。

questions.stem: Most of us enjoy __________to our mothers speak, because our brains greatly prefer the voices of our own mothers.
questions.reason: enjoy doing 表喜欢做某事，故填 listening；listen to our mothers speak 表听母亲说话。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 09 时态
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem:
— Have you told Dr. Green all our latest achievements in the vaccine research?
— Not yet. When I ____, he ____ a speech, so we had no time for a few words.
questions.reason: 叙述过去到达时的情景，When I arrived 用过去式；当时他正在演讲，用 was giving。

questions.stem:
— Listen! Amy, who ____ next door?
— Well, it's Cindy. Her voice always sounds ____ just like a bird.
questions.reason: Listen 提示正在唱歌，用 is singing；sounds 为系动词，后接形容词 sweet，不用 sweetly。

questions.stem: So far, the number of people using 5G mobile phones ____ a lot.
questions.reason: So far 表截至现在，用现在完成时；the number 作主语为单数，故 has increased。

questions.stem:
— Have you ever been to Shanghai?
— Of course. Actually, I ____ there for six years, but now I live in Beijing.
questions.reason: but now I live in Beijing 表上海的工作已结束，for six years 是过去的一段经历，用 worked。

questions.stem:
— What's your plan for the summer holiday?
— I'll go to Chendu as soon as the school term ___________.
questions.reason: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句为将来时，从句用一般现在时；term 单数，填 ends。

questions.stem:
— Alex, go and clean your bedroom.
— I __________ it. It's tidy and clean now.
questions.reason: 卧室现在整洁说明打扫已完成且结果仍在，用 have cleaned。

questions.stem:
— There __________ a basketball game against Class Two this Sunday.
— I see. I will come and cheer you on.
questions.reason: There be 句型的将来时为 There is going to be，不能把存在句 be 换成 have。

questions.stem:
— COVID -19 is spreading wildly in India. Take care!
— Yes. More than 300,000 people ________there.
questions.reason: 描述截至说话时已发生的累计死亡，用 have died；die 只表一般情况，are dying 表正在死亡。

questions.stem:
— Jack, how do you like the new movie Hi, Mom! directed（导演） by Jia Ling?
— Well, it's really a funny movie. I ____ it three times.
questions.reason: 已看过三次是截至现在的经历，用 have watched；原文 for three times 中 for 多余，通常说 three times。

questions.stem:
— Has your father come back yet?
— No. He _____ come back ______ this Sunday.
questions.reason: this Sunday 是将来时间，not … until 表直到……才，故为 won’t come back until。

questions.stem:
— Peter, what are you doing?
— Oh, I_________a report about national heroes.
questions.reason: 问正在做什么，答句用现在进行时 am writing。

questions.stem: Mr. Smith______ Chinese for two years. He's much better at it now.
questions.reason: for two years 与 now 的学习进步相联系，用现在完成时 has learned。

questions.stem: My parents and I_________ trees last Sunday.
questions.reason: last Sunday 为明确过去时间，谓语用过去式 planted。

questions.stem:
— Lily, what do you usually do after school?
— I_________exercise with my friends.
questions.reason: usually 表日常习惯，用一般现在时；主语I用动词原形 do。

questions.stem: I ____ this bike for three years. I like it so much.
questions.reason: for three years 表持续拥有三年，用 have had；buy 为瞬间动词，have bought 不能直接表示持续拥有。原题还漏了主语I。

questions.stem: Look! The musician ________ at the piano, ready to play.
questions.reason: Look 提示现在的状态或正在进行的动作，用 is sitting。

questions.stem:
— Where does Bill live?
— He ______ me his address, but I can't remember it now.
questions.reason: 告诉地址发生在过去，but I can’t remember it now 是现在的结果，前句用 told。

questions.stem:
— Is Helen here?
— No, she isn't here, She ________ in half an hour.
questions.reason: in half an hour 表半小时后，表示将来会到，用 will arrive。

questions.stem: I ________ books in the library when the rainstorm came.
questions.reason: when the rainstorm came 是过去动作发生时，读书正在进行，用 was reading。

questions.stem: While Linda was still sleeping, her mother____________ breakfast in the kitchen.
questions.reason: While Linda was still sleeping 限定过去那段时间，妈妈当时正在做早餐，用 was making。

questions.stem: Look! Julia as well as her sisters ________ a kite on the playground.
questions.reason: Look 提示现在进行时；as well as her sisters 不改变中心主语 Julia 的单数，故 is flying。

questions.stem: It ________ 100 years since the Communist Party ________ .
questions.reason: It has been … since … 表自过去某事以来已有多久；党是被成立的，从句用 was founded。

questions.stem: In the Past, people didn't know that the earth ________ around the sun.
questions.reason: 地球绕太阳转是客观事实，即使主句为过去时，从句仍用一般现在时 moves。

questions.stem:
— Dad, I can't find my school ID card. Did you see it?
— No, I didn't. I think you ________ it!
questions.reason: 现在找不到证件，推断已经把它弄丢，用 have lost 强调对现在的影响。

questions.stem:
— What were you doing at the time of the rainstorm yesterday?
— I ________ at the library after school.
questions.reason: at the time of the rainstorm yesterday 表过去某个时刻，当时正在读书，用 was reading。

questions.stem: Over the past few months, Chinese COVID vaccines (疫苗) ________ in many other countries.
questions.reason: Over the past few months 表过去数月一直到现在，用现在完成时；vaccines 复数，填 have arrived。

questions.stem: Hurry up! Mr. Brown ___________ for us in the meeting room at the moment.
questions.reason: at the moment 表此刻，Mr. Brown 单数，用 is waiting。

questions.stem:
— We __________ very simply and do not spend much money on food.
— That's why you're called the Greens.
questions.reason: 一般现在时描述一家人的日常饮食习惯，主语 We 接 eat。

questions.stem:
— What good books did you read recently?
— I ____ Tales of China since last year, and now this is the third time.
questions.reason: since last year 表从去年到现在，用 have read；第三次说明累计阅读次数。

questions.stem: The documentary Aerial China《航拍中国》is wonderful. So far, I ______ it three times.
questions.reason: So far 表截至目前，three times 为累计次数，用 have watched。

questions.stem: You can borrow this film—surely you ____ watching it.
questions.reason: 推荐借影片并预测借出后会喜欢，用将来时 will enjoy；原题在 you 后漏印空格。

questions.stem: William ____ six books, and all of them are bestsellers.
questions.reason: 已有六本作品且都成了畅销书，强调完成的成果，用 has written。

questions.stem: I saw Bob in the garden. He ____ flowers there.
questions.reason: I saw 为过去，看到Bob时他正在浇花，用 was watering。

questions.stem: In the past people didn't know that light ______________faster than sound.
questions.reason: 光比声音传播快为客观事实，从句不随过去主句改时态，用 travels，light 视为单数。

questions.stem:
— Did you hear that the Chinese skiing player, Gu Ailing, won the first prize?
— Yes, I _____________with my friends at that time.
questions.reason: at that time 指听到消息时的过去时刻，当时正在野餐，用 was having a picnic。

questions.stem: I'm sorry I didn't answer your call because I ________online.
questions.reason: 没接电话发生在过去，因为来电时正在上网学习，填 was studying。

questions.stem:
— I saw Alice walk into that building just now.
— Oh, it's our new city museum. It ________ to the public for a month.
questions.reason: for a month 要求可持续状态，open 是形容词，has been open 表开放已一个月；opened 是瞬间动作。

questions.stem: Mrs. Jones ______________in the garden at this time yesterday.
questions.reason: at this time yesterday 指昨天此刻，工作正在进行，用 was working。

questions.stem: Thanks to the use of 5G technology, ways of communication ______ a lot.
questions.reason: ways of communication 为复数，强调5G带来的既有变化，用 have improved。

questions.stem:
— Do you know Mount Wudang in Shiyan?
— Yes, I ______________it twice. It's fantastic.
questions.reason: 已登过武当山两次是截至现在的经历，用 have climbed；had climbed 需要另一个过去参照点。

questions.stem: Mid-Autumn Day usually__________ on August 15th in the lunar calendar（阴历）every year.
questions.reason: usually 和 every year 表每年规律；Mid-Autumn Day 为单数，填 comes。

questions.stem:
— May I use your dictionary?
— Sorry, I ____ it now.
questions.reason: now 提示现在正在使用词典，填 am using。

questions.stem:
— Treasure Island is exciting.
— I agree with you. I ____ it twice.
questions.reason: 已读两遍是到现在为止的阅读经历，用 have read，不需要过去完成时。

questions.stem: Look! Many people ____ in the park.
questions.reason: Look 提示当前正在跳舞；Many people 为复数，故 are dancing。

questions.stem:
— Do you know _______________, Alfred?
— At 2:00 tomorrow afternoon.

options.text: when did the end-of-term concert begin
when the end-of-term concert will begin
when will the end-of-term concert begin

questions.reason: 答句 tomorrow afternoon 确定将来时；宾语从句用陈述语序 when … will begin，选C。

questions.stem: I saw Julia in April and I ____________her since then.
questions.reason: since then 表从四月至今未再见，用现在完成时否定 haven’t seen。

questions.stem: During Dr Mar's last visit, he______________ on 150 patients on the ORBIS plane.
questions.reason: During … last visit 明确限定过去那次出访，填过去式 operated。

questions.stem:
— I lost my cellphone in the shopping mall yesterday.
— Why not go to the Lost and Found? They _____________ one.
questions.reason: 失物招领处已经找到一部手机，have found 强调找到后现在可去领取的结果。

questions.stem:
— It is reported that the First Flight Ceremony of Heze Mudan Airport was held on April 2nd, 2021.
— Yes. Great changes ________ in my hometown since I left home.
questions.reason: since I left home 表持续到现在的变化，用 have taken place；take place 无被动语态。

questions.stem: Last Sunday my brother and I _____________ our grandparents.
questions.reason: Last Sunday 表明确过去时间，主语是复数的我和哥哥，谓语仍用过去式 visited。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 10 被动语态
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem:
— I hear that you took part in a forest clean-up activity last Sunday.
— Yes, it ________ by our school green club to protect forests.
questions.reason: last Sunday 限定过去；活动由学校绿色俱乐部组织，it 是受事，用 was organized。

questions.stem:
— More and more high-technology products _____ in China.
— Yes. Our country is becoming stronger and stronger.
questions.reason: products 是复数，且产品被制造，用一般现在时被动 are made，不能用主动 are making。

questions.stem: His guitar __________ as a gift for him last week.
questions.reason: last week 表过去；guitar 是被买作礼物的，用 was bought。

questions.stem:
— Mum, could I watch the movie The Battle at Changjin Lake tonight?
— Of course, if your homework ______.
questions.reason: if 引导将来条件，从句用一般现在时；homework 被完成，用 is finished。

questions.stem: Few students could understand the sentence until it ________ by Miss Chen.
questions.reason: could 表过去语境；句子是被老师解释的，用 was explained，by 引出动作执行者。

questions.stem:
— Many DIY cards ________ to mothers on Mother's Day every year.
— How creative!
questions.reason: every year 表惯例；cards 为复数，且被送给母亲，用 are sent。

questions.stem: The Youth Sports Center on Zixiao Road ________ last year.
questions.reason: last year 表过去；体育中心是被建造的，填 was built。

questions.stem: A new supermarket___________ on Center Street next year.
questions.reason: next year 表将来；超市是被建造的，用 will be built。

questions.stem: The 24th Winter Olympic Games ________ in February, 2022, Beijing.
questions.reason: 题目叙述2022年2月那届冬奥会的举办，Games 在赛事名称中整体作单数，用 was held。

questions.stem: UNICEF, part of the United Nations, ________ in Europe in 1946 after World War II.
questions.reason: in 1946 限定过去；联合国儿童基金会是被设立的，用 was set up，set up 表建立。

questions.stem: I ________ by aliens on my way home the other day. Do you believe me?
questions.reason: the other day 表前几天；I 是被外星人袭击的对象，用 was attacked。

questions.stem: Five more clubs ________ next week to make our school life rich and colorful.
questions.reason: next week 表将来；clubs 被设立，用 will be set up。

questions.stem: Chinese _________ by more and more people in the world.
questions.reason: Chinese 指汉语，作单数；被越来越多人说，用 is spoken，by 引出使用者。

questions.stem: The police haven't found the little girl who ________ at a supermarket. They' ll keep doing all they can to find her.
questions.reason: 女孩被人带走，who 指 little girl，过去被动用 was taken away，不能只有 taken away 无谓语。

questions.stem: Last month, the little girl ________ well enough by the neighbors while her parents were volunteering.
questions.reason: Last month 是过去；女孩由邻居照顾，用 was cared for，介词 for 不可漏。

questions.stem: The public places, such as restaurants and cinemas, ________ since COVID-19 swept the city again last month.
questions.reason: since … last month 表持续到现在的关闭状态，places 为复数，用 have been closed。

questions.stem:
— The Law on Family Education Promotion (家庭教育促进法) _________ on Oct. 23, 2021.
— Yeah! It came into effect (生效) on Jan. 1, 2022.
questions.reason: 句中所给2021年日期表过去；法律被通过，用 was passed。此处考被动形式，不是 pass 的主动用法。

questions.stem: During the Tang dynasty(唐朝), nearly everything produced in the world __________ on the streets of Chang'an.
questions.reason: 在唐朝的语境中表示当时能在街上找到，用 could be found，could 后接 be + 过去分词。

questions.stem: A lot of birds ______ in nature parks every year.
questions.reason: every year 表规律；birds 是复数且为被保护者，用 are protected。

questions.stem: The tea in Yunnan is so famous that it ________ to places across the world every day.
questions.reason: every day 表日常；tea 是不可数名词且被运送，用 is sent。

questions.stem: Tea from China began to be sent abroad more than a thousand years ago and since then it ___________ to the world.
questions.reason: since then 要求现在完成时；茶被世人知晓，填 has been known，构成完成时被动。

questions.stem: Now waste from daily life in the city of Shanghai ______ to be separated into four different groups.
questions.reason: Now 为现在语境；waste 是被要求分类的，用 is required，require … to do 的被动为 be required to do。

questions.stem: The old lady __________ the hospital in time at last.
questions.reason: at last 表过去终于被及时送医，用 was taken to；take sb to hospital 的受事是老太太。

questions.stem: The kite ____ in China more than 2,000 years ago.
questions.reason: more than 2,000 years ago 表过去；风筝被发明，用 was invented，原题漏印空格。

questions.stem: When I was young, I ____________by my grandparents.
questions.reason: When I was young 表过去；I 被祖父母照顾，用 was looked after，after 不可漏。

questions.stem: Wuchazi Bridge ____________ as an Internet-famous place in Chengdu.
questions.reason: be regarded as 表被视为，桥为单数，用 is regarded as。

questions.stem: That machine is broken. It ________ tomorrow.
questions.reason: tomorrow 表将来；坏掉的机器被修理，填 will be repaired。

questions.stem: As the most exciting and traditional way to shop, street markets __________here and there in China these days.
questions.reason: these days 指现在的普遍情况；street markets 是复数且被发现到处都有，用 are found。

questions.stem: The 24th Winter Olympic Games ____________ in Beijing and Zhangjiakou in 2022.
questions.reason: 按题目赛前展望2022冬奥会的语境，赛事将被举办，用 will be held；will hold 是主动，缺主办者意义。

questions.stem: In Miss Lin's class, many chances ___________ to students to learn from each other.
questions.reason: 学生是获得机会的一方，many chances 为复数受事，用 are offered。

questions.stem:
— Do you need any help?
— No, thanks. We ______________ a lot of support since last year.
questions.reason: since last year 表从去年到现在；We 获得他人支持，用 have been offered。

questions.stem:
— Mr. White, when shall I hand in my report?
— As soon as it ________ tomorrow.
questions.reason: as soon as 引导将来时间从句，用一般现在时；report 是被完成的，填 is finished。

questions.stem:
— What language ________ in Canada?
— Both English and French.
questions.reason: language 为单数，问加拿大使用什么语言，被动形式为 is spoken。

questions.stem:
— Krystal, do you know how tea is produced?
— Yes. When tea leaves are ready, they are picked by hand and then ____ for processing.
questions.reason: 介绍制茶的通常流程，用一般现在时；they 指茶叶，和 are picked 并列，应为 are sent。

questions.stem: You ____ lunch at school. So you don't have to bring your own food.
questions.reason: You 接受学校提供的午餐，用 are given；give sb lunch 的被动可让受益者作主语。

questions.stem:
— China is getting stronger and stronger.
— Yes. So Chinese ____ by more and more foreigners.
questions.reason: Chinese 指汉语，为单数受事；描述当前越来越多人学，用 is learned。

questions.stem: It's said that tea _________________ to Korea and Japan from China in the 6th and 7th centuries.
questions.reason: in the 6th and 7th centuries 是过去；茶被带到日韩，用 was brought。

questions.stem: A number of volunteers will ______________ for the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Games.
questions.reason: will 后跟动词原形；志愿者将被需要，用 be needed，不能接 are needed。

questions.stem: In our English class, many chances ________ to students to show themselves.
questions.reason: 课堂上学生被提供展示机会，chances 复数，填 are offered。

questions.stem: It ________ 100 years since the Communist Party ________ .
questions.reason: since 从句用过去时 was founded，主句表示已过100年用 has been；党为被成立，不能用主动 founded。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 11 祈使句/感叹句
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: On April 29, China successfully launched the Tianhe at the Wenchang Space Launch Centre in Hainan. ____ exciting news!
questions.reason: 感叹中心词 news 不可数，用 What + 形容词 + news，不加 an；原题在 exciting 前漏空格。

questions.stem: ____ to use sunglasses to stop the sun from shining directly in your eyes.
questions.reason: 祈使句省略主语you，句首用动词原形 Remember，remember to do 表记得去做。

questions.stem:
— _______ fun it is to go to Mount bang after the graduation examination !
— Yes let's go together.
questions.reason: fun 此处为不可数名词，用 What fun it is …，不能加 a。

questions.stem:
— Li Tao, there will be a big concert in our city next month.
— Oh, _______ exciting news.
questions.reason: news 不可数，感叹句用 what exciting news，不用 what a 或 how。

questions.stem:
— ________ fast China is developing!
— Yes, we are so lucky to live in such a great country!
questions.reason: fast 为修饰 developing 的副词，感叹结构为 How + 副词 + 主语 + 谓语。

questions.stem:
— ________ your hands before dinner, Tony.
— No problem, Mom.
questions.reason: 向Tony提出饭前洗手的要求，为祈使句，用动词原形 Wash。

questions.stem: Bill went to watch the boat races.____________ fantastic the dragon boat teams were!
questions.reason: fantastic 为形容词，后已接主语 the dragon boat teams，句首用 How。

questions.stem:
— Our class won the first prize in today's basketball match.
— _______ exciting news it is! We're all glad about it.
questions.reason: news 不可数，用 What exciting news it is，不加 an。

questions.stem: ____________ great progress my daughter has made!
questions.reason: progress 是不可数名词，What great progress … 表多么大的进步。

questions.stem:
— We all know that the 24th Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing.
— That's true. ________ exciting news it is!
questions.reason: news 不可数，感叹其令人振奋用 What exciting news it is。

questions.stem: _____it over, and you will be able to work out the problem.
questions.reason: 祈使句 + and + 陈述句 表做某事就会有结果，句首用 Think it over。

questions.stem: ___________ helpful advice she gave me on how to get on with others!
questions.reason: advice 不可数，用 What helpful advice，不加 a。

questions.stem:
— ____ heavy! I can't move the bag.
— Don't worry! Let me help you.
questions.reason: 此处省略了 the bag is，How heavy! 直接感叹重量这一形容词性质。

questions.stem:
— Yuan Longping, the father of hybrid rice, passed away on May 22.
— ___________sad news! His death is a huge loss for our country.
questions.reason: sad news 的中心词 news 不可数，感叹句用 What sad news。

questions.stem:
— China's women's soccer team won a ticket to the Tokyo Olympics.
— Wow! ______ great they are! We are proud ______ them.
questions.reason: great 后接主语 they，填 How；be proud of sb 表为某人骄傲，第二空 of。

questions.stem:
— He has made many friends since he came here three weeks ago.
— _______________outgoing boy he is!
questions.reason: boy 为单数可数名词，outgoing 以元音音素开头，故用 What an outgoing boy。

questions.stem:
— They've bought the sick children some toys and flowers.
— So they have. _________nice of them!
questions.reason: 感叹 nice 这一形容词，How nice of them 省略了 it is，不能套 what + 名词。

questions.stem:
— ___________ nice weather it is to go hiking! Would you like to go with me?
— Good idea! Let's go.
questions.reason: weather 为不可数名词，用 What nice weather it is，不加 a。

questions.stem: ________ important it is for teenagers to be creative!
questions.reason: important 后直接接主语 it，用 How important it is …，后面的 for teenagers 不改变感叹结构。

questions.stem:
— _____ nice music lesson Mrs Wu gave us today!
— Yes. We enjoyed it very much.
questions.reason: lesson 为单数可数名词，感叹结构用 What a nice music lesson。

questions.stem: _______ at people when you talk. This is a polite way of communication in China.
questions.reason: 提醒对方交流时看着别人，用祈使句动词原形 Look，look at 表看着。

questions.stem:
— Ivy, ___________hard you are working!
— President Xi always says that the more hard-working we are, the luckier we will be.
questions.reason: hard 为修饰 are working 的副词，How hard you are working 表你工作多么努力。

questions.stem: __________ interesting stories they are!
questions.reason: stories 为复数可数名词，用 What interesting stories，不加 an。

questions.stem: __________ walk on the grass.
questions.reason: 否定祈使句为 Don’t + 动词原形，填 Don’t walk。

questions.stem:
— The little boy is only three years old, but he can memorize about 50 poems.
— ___________talented boy he is!
questions.reason: boy 为单数可数名词，talented 以辅音音素开头，用 What a talented boy。

questions.stem:
— ________ hot weather it is! Why not have a cold drink?
— Sounds good! Let's go.
questions.reason: weather 不可数，What hot weather it is 不加 a。

questions.stem: When I want to go out to play with my friends, my mother always says, "____________ at home. Don't waste your time."
questions.reason: 母亲发出待在家的要求，祈使句用原形 Stay，省略主语you。

questions.stem:
— ____________ terrible mess you have made!
— Sorry, Mum. I will clear it up right now.
questions.reason: mess 在 make a mess 中为可数用法，感叹为 What a terrible mess。

questions.stem:
— ________ unusual year 2020 is!
— Yeah! The pandemic (大疫情) is a challenge not only to China but also to the world.
questions.reason: year 为单数可数名词，unusual 以元音音素开头，填 What an。

questions.stem: ________ amazing the story is! I want to read it again.
questions.reason: amazing 后面已经是 the story is，直接感叹形容词，用 How。

questions.stem:
— ________ wonderful the music is!
— Yes. It makes me relaxed after a busy day.
questions.reason: wonderful 后接主语 the music，结构为 How wonderful the music is，不用 What a。

questions.stem:
— Pingtang Bridge has the highest concrete bridge tower in the world.
— ____ amazing it is!
questions.reason: amazing 后接 it is，故 How amazing it is；如果用 What an，后面必须有单数名词。

questions.stem:
— Chinese government has successfully stopped the virus from spreading in China.
— ______________proud we Chinese feel!
questions.reason: proud 为 feel 的表语，后接 we Chinese feel，用 How proud 感叹自豪的程度。

questions.stem:
— Did you take part in Dayang Bay Yancheng Marathon on April 21?
— Yes. ________ hard work!
questions.reason: work 在此表示辛苦工作，为不可数名词，用 What hard work，不加 a。

questions.stem: ________ special the classes are! They have learned a lot about drawing.
questions.reason: special 为形容词，后已有主语 the classes，故 How special the classes are。

questions.stem:
— Look! The elephants are dancing to music.
— ________ smart they are!
questions.reason: 感叹大象聪明，smart 后接 they are，填 How。

questions.stem:
— All of my classmates have passed the English test.
— ____ exciting the news is!
questions.reason: 虽然 news 不可数，但本句结构是形容词 exciting + 主语 the news + is，应填 How。

questions.stem: ______useful the information you've provided is!
questions.reason: useful 后已接主语 the information … 和 is，用 How useful …；不能只看到 information 就选 What。

questions.stem: ______on the grass. It's a rule of the park.
questions.reason: 公园规定不踩草坪，用否定祈使句 Don’t step on the grass。

questions.stem: ______useful advice you gave us!
questions.reason: advice 为不可数名词，感叹结构是 What useful advice you gave us，不加 a。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 12 连词
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: In Chinese culture, the young won't start dinner ____ the elders take their seats.
questions.reason: won’t … until … 表直到长辈落座才开始吃饭，not 与 until 构成“直到……才”。

questions.stem: Love your parents ____ they are alive. Don't wait until it is too late.
questions.reason: 趁父母健在时爱他们，用 while 表在……期间；after 表之后，不合提醒及时关爱的语意。

questions.stem:
— Does Lisa come from the US ________ the UK?
— Sorry, I don't know.
questions.reason: 询问来自美国还是英国，为选择疑问句，用 or 连接两个备选项。

questions.stem: This dress is very beautiful, ______ it doesn't look good on me.
questions.reason: 裙子漂亮却不适合自己，前后意思转折，用 but。

questions.stem:
— Although Zhong Nanshan knows COVID-19 is more ____ to old people, _____ he cares little for his own safety.
— He is the pride of us. We all respect him.
questions.reason: be 动词后用形容词 dangerous；although 已引导让步从句，主句不再用 but，选 dangerous; /。

questions.stem:
— Has your father come back yet?
— No. He _____ come back ______ this Sunday.
questions.reason: this Sunday 表将来，not … until 表直到周日才回，用 won’t; until。

questions.stem: The doctors worked for ten hours, ___________nobody took a break.
questions.reason: 工作十小时本应休息，但无人休息，填 but 表转折；so 表结果，不合此处语意。

questions.stem: The great scientist Yuan Longping left us last month, ________ he will live in our hearts for ever.
questions.reason: 虽然袁隆平逝世，但会永远活在人们心中，用 but 表转折。

questions.stem:
— We can't get on or off a bus ______ it is moving.
— You're right.
questions.reason: while it is moving 表公交正在行驶期间，说明这时不能上下车。

questions.stem: We won't believe it ________ we see it with our own eyes.
questions.reason: won’t … unless … 表除非亲眼看到，否则不相信；unless 相当于 if … not。

questions.stem: Jason will go to visit his grandparents ____________ he finishes his work this weekend.
questions.reason: 周末完成工作是去看祖父母的条件，用 if；unless 表除非，会颠倒条件。

questions.stem:
— I can't get on well with my family.
— Why not talk with them? You should communicate ________ things become worse.
questions.reason: 应在情况恶化之前交流，用 before；after 则是恶化之后才沟通。

questions.stem: Nowadays you are supposed to have your temperature taken _______ you enter the school.
questions.reason: 按题意测体温发生在进入学校之前，选 before。

questions.stem: ______ he heard the little girl crying for help outside, he rushed out of the room.
questions.reason: 听到呼救便立即冲出去，用 As soon as 表一……就……。

questions.stem: I love to listen to rock music ____ I am running.
questions.reason: 听摇滚乐和跑步同时进行，用 while 引导正在跑步的时间背景。

questions.stem: Your parents won't let you go out alone ________ they are sure you're safe.
questions.reason: 父母只有确信安全才允许独自出门，won’t … unless … 表除非……否则不……。

questions.stem: She can't sleep well __________too much noise next door.
questions.reason: too much noise 为名词短语，前用 because of；because、since 引导的原因部分需为完整从句。

questions.stem: You don't need to take any cash (现金) when shopping. You may pay by________ Alipay (支付宝)__________WeChat (微信).
questions.reason: 两种支付方式任选其一，用 either … or …；neither … nor … 表两者都不。

questions.stem: Boys and girls, read the new words again ______ you forget.
questions.reason: 为避免遗忘，在忘掉之前再读一遍，用 before。

questions.stem:
— How do you like the singing competition yesterday?
— Exciting, ______ some students didn't do very well.
questions.reason: 整体觉得比赛激动人心，尽管有些人表现不好，用 though 表让步。

questions.stem:
— I'm afraid I can't do well in the sports meeting.
— Don't worry. I will support you, ____________you don't succeed.
questions.reason: 即使比赛不成功也支持，用 even if 表即便；so that 表目的，不合此意。

questions.stem:
— Do you know the woman ____ wears a blue skirt?
— Oh, she's my aunt.
questions.reason: 空后缺 wears 的主语，先行词 woman 指人，用关系代词 who 引导定语从句。

questions.stem: ________ he is 72 years old, ________ he keeps running every day.
questions.reason: 虽然72岁却仍坚持跑步，用 Although 引导从句；主句不能重复使用 but。

questions.stem: You need to practise speaking every day _________ you hope to improve your spoken English.
questions.reason: 想提升口语是每天练习的条件，用 if；unless 表如果不，与句意相反。

questions.stem: Read the book Cute Pets, _________ you will know how to take care of your cat.
questions.reason: 祈使句 + and + 将来时陈述句 表读这本书就能学会照顾猫，and 连接行为及正向结果。

questions.stem: _________ I walk around in this small town, what I see makes me think of my childhood.
questions.reason: walk around 缺地点状语，Wherever 表无论走到哪里；Whatever 是无论什么，不表地点。

questions.stem:
— Paul is badly hurt on the playground. Let's help him up.
— Don't move him ______________ you know some first-aid knowledge.
questions.reason: 按题意，除非懂急救知识，否则不要移动伤者，用 unless 表必要条件。这里只辨析原句条件关系。

questions.stem: More and more children are interested in blind boxes __________ they wonder what is inside.
questions.reason: 好奇盒子里的东西是喜欢盲盒的原因，用 because，引导原因从句。

questions.stem: We were lucky yesterday. The bus left ____________we got on it.
questions.reason: 刚上车公交就开走了，用 as soon as 表一……就……，与幸运赶上车呼应。

questions.stem: ___________ we continue to pull together, we'll keep winning the game.
questions.reason: 只要继续齐心协力就能赢，用 As long as 表条件；as soon as 表时间先后。

questions.stem: Please don't hurt the little animals ________ you see them on the street. They are our friends.
questions.reason: 看到街上小动物时不要伤害，用 when 引导时间从句。

questions.stem: My cousin became a country doctor ________ he finished medical school.
questions.reason: 先完成医学院学习，后当乡村医生，用 after 表在……之后。

questions.stem: We can achieve our dream ________ we don't give up hope in the face of difficulties.
questions.reason: 不放弃希望是实现梦想的条件，用 as long as；so that 表目的，even though 表让步。

questions.stem: At the meeting, the managers kept arguing about the problem ______ they reached an agreement.
questions.reason: 争论持续到达成一致为止，用 until 与 kept arguing 的持续性呼应。

questions.stem: We should take the rest of the food home ____ we can't finish what we order.
questions.reason: 如果吃不完点的菜，就应该打包带走，用 if 表条件。

questions.stem:
— Would you like to help me clean the house this weekend?
— I'd like to ____I finish my homework.
questions.reason: 愿意帮忙以完成作业为前提，用 if；before 则变成写作业前就帮忙，未体现这一前提。

questions.stem: _______________you practice every day, you won't make any progress.
questions.reason: 不每天练习就不会有进步，Unless相当于If … not；Although表让步，不能准确表达练习是进步所需条件。

questions.stem:
— Hurry up, dear! ____ we won't catch up with the train.
— Don't worry! Time is still enough ____ we can make it.
questions.reason: Hurry up 后的 Or 表否则赶不上；时间充足与能赶上列车同向连接，用 and，故 Or; and。

questions.stem:
— I'm afraid that we can't ____ the math problem ____ the teacher helps us.
— That's true. It's too difficult.
questions.reason: work out 表解决数学题，work on 只是从事；除非老师帮忙否则解不出，用 unless。

questions.stem: Mary shut the window just now ______ she could keep the insects out.
questions.reason: 关窗的目的是把昆虫挡在外面，用 so that 引导目的从句，与 could 连用。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 13 定语从句
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料有9题因原题歧义或缺少判定依据标为待核对，暂不计分。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem: Rome is an ancient city ____ is full of places of interest.
questions.reason: 先行词 ancient city 指物，空在从句中作 is 的主语，用 which；where 只能作地点状语。原文 hill of 疑为 full of 的错印。

questions.stem:
— Do you like the movie ___________is called The Battle at Lake Changjin?
— Sure. I think no movie is ___________than it.
questions.reason: movie 指物，关系代词用 that；电影令人感动，用 touching，than 前填比较级 more touching。

questions.stem: We should remember those ________ lost their lives for our country.
questions.reason: those 指为国牺牲的人，关系代词在从句中作 lost 的主语，用 who；whom 作宾语。

questions.stem:
— Tom, where do you work?
— I work in a shop ____ sells different kinds of vegetables.
questions.reason: shop 虽是地点，但从句缺 sells 的主语，需用 which，不能用只作地点状语的 where。

questions.stem:
— Do you like the weekly talk show, The Reader, on CCTV?
— Sure. It's a great TV programme _________ brings the habit of reading back into the public.
questions.reason: programme 指物，关系代词作 brings 的主语，用 that；what 不能引导有明确先行词的此类定语从句。

questions.stem: Abing's Erquan Nngyue is a piece of music __________ has become one of China's national treasures.
questions.reason: a piece of music 指物，关系代词在从句中作 has become 的主语，填 which。

questions.stem: I like smart clothes ____are made of silk.
questions.reason: clothes 指物，关系代词作 are made 的主语，用 which；what 不能直接接在先行词后代替关系代词。

questions.stem: This is the first birthday gift __________I received. I've kept it many years.
questions.reason: gift被first修饰，考试常推荐that；但在现代英语限定性定语从句中which也可作received的宾语。A、B均有语法依据，不将推荐用法当唯一规则。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Do you know the woman ____ wears a blue skirt?
— Oh, she's my aunt.
questions.reason: woman 指人，从句缺 wears 的主语，填 who。

questions.stem: Chaka Salt Lake __________ is known as Mirror of the Sky interests more and more tourists.
questions.reason: Chaka Salt Lake 指物，从句缺 is known 的主语，用 which；where 不能代替主语。

questions.stem:
— Do you know the boy ____ is sitting next to Peter?
— Yes. He's Peter's friend. They are celebrating his ____ birthday.
questions.reason: boy 指人且关系词作主语，that 可用且不能省略；第九写作 ninth，不是 nineth，故B两空都正确。

questions.stem: The writer and his novel ____ you have just talked about are really well-known.
questions.reason: 先行词同时包含 writer 和 novel，即人和物，用 that 统一引导定语从句。

questions.stem: The Sun Island is the first place ____ almost all the travelers would like to visit when they come to Harbin.
questions.reason: place指物，从句visit缺宾语，that、which均可作关系代词；first修饰时考试常推荐that，但A、C不宜机械唯一判分。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Do you like the novel?
— Yes, I do. It is the first novel ________ I have read three times.
questions.reason: novel 被 first 修饰，按限定性定语从句常见考试用法填 that，作 have read 的宾语。

questions.stem: A person _______ follows his dream and puts his heart into it will be successful in the end.
questions.reason: person 指人，关系词在从句中作 follows 的主语，用 who；whose 表所属。

questions.stem: Titanic is the most interesting movie __________I've seen. I like it very much.
questions.reason: movie指物，从句I’ve seen缺宾语；最高级后考试常推荐that，但which并非一概错误，A、B均有语法依据。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Basketball is deeply loved by teenagers in our school ______________ enjoy playing it for fun and exercise.
— I can't agree with you more. I also like playing basketball very much.
questions.reason: 先行词是 teenagers，不是 school；从句 enjoy 的主语指学生们，用 who。

questions.stem: We still remember the teachers _______________ have taught us for 3 years.
questions.reason: teachers 指人，关系词作 have taught 的主语，用 who；whom 不能作主语。

questions.stem: David is really interested in the universe, so recently he would like to buy a __________.

options.text: story book that describes Lingling's school life in Australia
science book that tells the advantages of cleaning machines
CD that shows the journeys to other planets by spaceship
magazine that introduces a special way to stop air pollution

questions.reason: interested in the universe 提示宇宙主题，只有C的乘飞船到其他行星的旅程切合兴趣，其他选项主题不符。

questions.stem:
— Harbin is the most beautiful city __________________ I've been to.
— So it is. Many tourists are attracted there every year.
questions.reason: city虽受最高级修饰，that、which在限定性从句中仍都可作been to的宾语；考试常推荐A，不能据此一律判B错。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Have you heard of the story of Mulan?
— Of course. Mulan is a brave girl ____takes her father's place to fight in the army.
questions.reason: girl 指人，从句 takes her father’s place 缺主语，用 who，takes one’s place 表代替某人。

questions.stem:
— I am glad to see____________.
— Yes. Students can join in different kinds of activities.

options.text: that there is less stress of learning for middle school students
what there is less stress of learning for middle school students
that is there less stress of learning for middle school students
what is there less stress of learning for middle school students

questions.reason: see 后接内容完整的宾语从句，用 that；从句保持 there is 的陈述语序，what 会多出句子成分。

questions.stem: Do you know the city, Kunming, ____________is the capital city of Yunan?
questions.reason: Kunming 指城市，从句缺 is 的主语，用 which；where 只能作地点状语，不能代替主语。

questions.stem: Thanks to a passenger at the airport, I found the passport _______ I lost.
questions.reason: passport 指物，从句 I lost 缺宾语，用 which；what 不能在 passport 后作此类关系词。

questions.stem:
— Parents' love is deep and endless (无尽的). No matter where we go, the door of love will keep open for us.
— Their love is just like an umbrella ____ protects us from wind or rain.
questions.reason: umbrella 指物，关系代词作 protects 的主语，用 which。

questions.stem:
— ________ kind of tea would you like?
— I love tea ________has a fruity taste.
questions.reason: What kind of tea 询问茶的种类；第二空 tea 指物，关系代词作 has 的主语，用 which。

questions.stem: The UNICEF（联合国儿童基金会）have helped more children get the chances to go to school with the money__________ people raise.
questions.reason: money 指物，从句 people raise 缺宾语，用 which，不能用表地点的 where。

questions.stem:
— Our class needs some _____for the school leavers' party?
— Maybe Linda can help. She can draw very well.

options.text: tools which can keep our hall clean
food which is offered to the students
Students who can make invitation cards
Teachers who can sing very well

questions.reason: Linda画画好，可帮助制作邀请卡，选需要能制作邀请卡的学生；students 指人，后接 who。

questions.stem: A city's landmark(地标) is usually the first thing _____ attracts(吸引) a tourist. It is a symbol of the city and also a window of the local culture.
questions.reason: thing被first修饰时常推荐that，但which同样能在限定性从句中作attracts的主语；A、B均有语法依据。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem: My People Mr Country is the movie ________ has been popular for a long time.
questions.reason: movie 指物，关系词作 has been 的主语，用 which；what 不能跟在明确先行词后充当此类关系词。

questions.stem:
— Why are you so worried?
— I've lost the watch_______ my dad bought me on my birthday.
questions.reason: watch 指物，从句 my dad bought me 缺直接宾语，用 which；whose 表所属，后需接名词。

questions.stem: I like to watch the movies ___________help me relax after a long week at work.
questions.reason: movies 指物，从句 help me relax 缺主语，用 that；where 只能作状语。

questions.stem:
— Have you found the information _______________ you can use for the report?
— Not yet. I'll search for some on the Internet.
questions.reason: information 指物，从句 you can use 缺宾语，用 which。

questions.stem: I really admire those volunteers _________________ can offer to help people in trouble.
questions.reason: volunteers 指人，关系词作 can offer 的主语，用 who，whom 不能作主语。

questions.stem: Tu Youyou is the first Chinese ____won the Nobel Prize in science.
questions.reason: Chinese 在此指“中国人”，从句 won 缺主语；who 能指人，that 在这一限定性从句中也可指人，原选项B、C均有依据，不作唯一判分。
questions.examNote: who和that在本句限定性定语从句中都能指人并作主语，B、C均有依据，暂不唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Can you tell me ___________________ Huang Hua will give us a speech this afternoon?
— Yes, he will. He is the top student ___________________ we all admire.
questions.reason: 第一空询问黄华是否演讲，用 whether；第二空 student 指人，that 作 admire 的宾语。

questions.stem:
— Which is your new neighbour, Liu Hua?
— The man ______________________ T-shirt is red.
questions.reason: T-shirt 与 man 是所属关系，whose T-shirt 表那个人的T恤；who 不能直接修饰名词。

questions.stem: We're talking about the piano and the pianist ______________________ were in the concert we attended last night.
questions.reason: 先行词同时含 piano 和 pianist，即物和人，用 that，而非只指人的 who 或通常指物的 which。

questions.stem:
— Nowadays WeChat is very popular among friends.
— Yes. It seems to be the best way of communication ______________________ people like.
questions.reason: way在本句表示被人喜欢的交流方式，like缺宾语，that、which均能补足；best并不使which在现代英语中一概错误，A、B不宜唯一判分。
questions.examNote: 保留考试常用that的提示，但which也能构成此处限定性定语从句，暂不作唯一计分。

questions.stem:
— Is there anyone here ______________________ name is Betty?
— Sorry, I don't know.
questions.reason: name 属于前面的 anyone，用 whose name 表名字是Betty的人，whose 作定语。

questions.stem: A WeChat(微信) is an invention ______________________ can help people talk to friends，share photos, ideas and feelings freely.
questions.reason: invention 指物，关系词作 can help 的主语，用 which；关系词作主语时不能省略。

questions.stem: Tommy couldn't stop thinking about the boy ______________________ made him a fool in front of the whole class.
questions.reason: boy 指人，从句 made him a fool 缺主语，填 who；whom 为宾格关系代词。

questions.stem: People ______________________ overweight need more water than thin people.
questions.reason: People 指复数的人，关系代词用 who，be 动词与 People 一致用 are，故 who are。

questions.stem: I have some books _______ I bought in Nanjing last year.
questions.reason: books 指物，从句 I bought 缺宾语，用 that；where 作状语，不符合缺宾语的结构。

questions.stem: I still remember the names of the teachers _________ taught me in my primary school.
questions.reason: teachers 指人，关系词作 taught 的主语，填 who；whom 不能作主语。

questions.stem: Friends are those ____ make you smile, always open their hearts to you and encourage you to achieve your dreams.
questions.reason: those 在此指朋友，关系代词作 make 的主语，who、that 均可指人，所以A、C都成立，保持多解提示。
questions.examNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。
questions.originalExamNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。

questions.stem:
— Where did you get your hair ________? Your hair's style is so cool!
— I went to the barber's. Look! That is the barbershop __________ I cut my hair.
questions.reason: get one’s hair cut 表让人理发，cut 为过去分词；barbershop 后从句不缺宾语、缺地点状语，用 where。

questions.stem:
— I am very happy that the wonderful Middle-Autumn Day will come.
— Yes. The happiest time we students are looking forward to __________ in a few days.
questions.reason: 主句中心主语是 The happiest time；we students are looking forward to 为定语从句，主句缺谓语，填 is coming。

questions.stem: Friends are those _______ make you smile, always open their hearts to you and encourage you to achieve your dreams.
questions.reason: those 指能让你微笑的朋友，who 和 that 均可作从句主语；A、C都成立，不能强行唯一判分。
questions.examNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。
questions.originalExamNote: 原答案表标注 A/C（均正确）；本题为单项选择，存在多个可选答案，暂不计分。

questions.stem:
— John has a lot of friends ________ have a lot _________ common with himself.
— Indeed. Birds of a feather flock together.
questions.reason: friends 指人，who 作 have 的主语；have … in common with 表与……有共同之处，第二空 in。

title: 2025单招1000题 · 14 宾语从句
source: 2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf
notes: 来源：2025年高职单招英语1000道单招题库(1).pdf；参考答案：2025高职单招英语1000题答案(2).pdf。
本批解析为本项目逐题补编，语法解释具体选词与句型，阅读说明本篇原文依据，翻译解释本句关键表达；不是原书解析。
本资料题目已逐题配有解析。阅读答案依据原文独立核对，不机械套用无篇号答案表；翻译答案允许其他准确表达。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, could you tell me ________?
— You can take No 6 bus there. It's about 15 minutes' ride.

options.text: how far is the Slender West Lake
how far the Slender West Lake is
how can I get to the Slender West Lake
how I can get to the Slender West Lake

questions.reason: 答句给乘6路公交的方法，应用 how 而非问距离的 how far；从句用 I can get 的陈述语序，选D。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ______ life will be different in the future.
— Maybe we will be able to live on another planet with the development of space technology.
questions.reason: 答句说明未来生活将以何种方式不同，how life will be different 问生活会怎样变化。

questions.stem:
— Nancy, do you know ________?
— In 1957, I think.

options.text: what the play Teahouse is about
when the play Teahouse was written
why Lao She wrote the play Teahouse

questions.reason: In 1957 是时间，需 when；《茶馆》被写成，从句用陈述语序 when … was written。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ___________late for school yesterday.
— Bad luck! I got up late and missed the bus.
questions.reason: 起晚、错过公交解释迟到原因，用 why；宾语从句为 why you were，不能倒装成 why were you。

questions.stem:
— Can you tell me_____.
— Yes. In the language center.

options.text: where will the speech competition be held
where the speech competition will be held
when will the speech competition be held
when the speech competition will be held

questions.reason: 答句 In the language center 是地点，用 where；从句按 the competition will be held 排列。

questions.stem:
— Could you tell me_____________ for the fruit?
— You can just pay on the phone.
questions.reason: on the phone 说明支付方式，应问 how 而非 how much；从句用 how I will pay。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, do you know__________?
— Yes. Next Friday

options.text: when will the volunteers come back
when the volunteers will come back
how will the volunteers come back
how the volunteers will come back

questions.reason: Next Friday 回答时间，用 when；宾语从句用 the volunteers will come back 的陈述语序。

questions.stem:
— Have you decided ________ the children in the poor area?
— By sending them books and schoolbags.
questions.reason: By sending books and schoolbags 回答帮助方式，用 how；从句为 you will help，不能 will you help。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, I'm new here. Could you tell me ________?
— Sure. Go along this road, and you can't miss it.

options.text: how can I get to the museum
how I can get to the museum

questions.stem:
— I wonder ________.
— It was wonderful! We had fun at the city park.

options.text: why you were busy last weekend

questions.stem:
— Kate, do you know______?
— In the school hall.

options.text: when we'll have the English party
why we'll have the English party
where we'll have the English party

questions.reason: In the school hall 回答地点，用 where；后接 we’ll have 的陈述语序。

questions.stem:
— Could you tell me ________?
— In Fuzhou University.
questions.reason: In Fuzhou University 回答在哪里学习，选 where your brother is studying。

questions.stem:
— Excuse me, could you tell me ________?
— Sure. Walk along the street for about 10 minutes. You will see it on your right.

options.text: when the Science Museum is open
how I can get to the Science Museum
how old the Science Museum is

questions.reason: 答句是步行路线，用 how I can get to the Science Museum 问去科技馆的方法。

questions.stem: He asked me ________.

options.text: where can he find a supermarket
if I know the way to the supermarket
how he could get to the supermarket

questions.reason: asked 为过去，从句采用 could；从句用 he could get 的陈述语序。B中的 know 未按此过去语境呼应。

questions.stem: I plan to go to the art museum, but I'm not sure ________.
questions.reason: 询问到美术馆的方式，用 how；从句保持 I can get 的陈述语序，不能 can I get。

questions.stem:
— Could you please tell me _________ buy a magazine?
— There is a bookstore on the third floor.
questions.reason: 答句说明书店位置，问在哪里买用 where；宾语从句为 where I can buy。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ______.
— I'm not sure. Maybe next week.

options.text: who will give us a talk
when her baby will be born

questions.reason: Maybe next week 回答时间，只有 when her baby will be born 询问何时发生。

questions.stem: I wasn't sure what to write for my school project, so I asked my Dad ____________I should do.
questions.reason: do 缺宾语，what I should do 表我应该做什么；how、where 不能代替 do 的宾语。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ________.
— Yes, it tastes really nice.

options.text: where we can buy this kind of zongzi
how much we should pay for this kind of zongzi

questions.reason: Yes 与 tastes really nice 回应是否好吃，选 if Jiaxing zongzi is delicious，if 表是否。

questions.stem:
— Can you tell me __________?
— To get practical skills.

options.text: what do you learn about safety
when do you have the art festival
how you balance your studies and hobbies
why you learn cooking at school

questions.reason: To get practical skills 回答学习做饭的目的，应用 why；从句按 you learn 的陈述语序排列。

questions.stem:

— I can't. Mom said I __________ clean my bedroom before doing anything else.
questions.reason: Mom said 后转述必须先打扫的要求，用 had to；used to 表过去习惯，不表示必须。

questions.stem:
— Jenny, do you know ________?
— Er, next Tuesday.

options.text: when the sports meeting will take place
when will the sports meeting take place
where the sports meeting will take place
where will the sports meeting take place

questions.reason: next Tuesday 回答何时举行，用 when；take place 为不及物短语，从句是 the meeting will take place。

questions.stem:
— Could you tell me ______?
— It's about 6,300 kilometres long.

options.text: how wide is the Changjiang River
how wide the Changjiang River is
how long is the Changjiang River
how long the Changjiang River is

questions.reason: 6300 kilometres long 回答长度，用 how long；从句用 the Changjiang River is，不倒装。

questions.stem:
— Could you please tell me ________ when they meet for the first time in China?
— They usually shake hands.
questions.reason: shake hands 回答见面做什么，用 what；宾语从句用 people usually do 的陈述语序。

questions.stem:

— Oh, I bought them in the post office next to the bank.
questions.reason: 答句给购买邮票的地点，选 where；已购买用过去式 bought，从句为 where you bought them。

questions.stem:

— Yes. In Beijing and Zhangjiakou.

options.text: what cities it will be held in
what cities will it be held in

questions.reason: 答句是北京、张家口两座城市，询问 what cities；从句用 it will be held in 的陈述语序。

questions.stem:
— Jerry, could you remember ____?
— Have you forgotten we agreed to go to the Summer Palace?

options.text: where we are going to after the exam
where are we going to after the exam
where are we going after the exam
where we are going after the exam

questions.reason: Summer Palace 回答目的地，用 where；where 已作地点状语，后面的 go 不再加 to，选 where we are going。

questions.stem:
— Did you notice __________ in his office?
— Yes, he was going over our homework.
questions.reason: was going over our homework 说明当时在做什么，填 what Mr. Li was doing，兼顾过去时和陈述语序。

questions.stem:
— I wonder __________
— You can eat more fruit and vegetables and have a good living habit.
questions.reason: 答句给保持健康的方法，问 how；从句用 I can keep healthy，不能 can I keep healthy。

questions.stem:
— I wonder ______.
— Where there is a will, there is a way.

options.text: if will I pass the exam.
if I can become an artist.
if can I enter a good senior high school

questions.reason: 宾语从句用 if I can … 的陈述语序，只有B符合；A、C把助动词移到主语之前了。

questions.stem:
— Miss Liu, can you tell me ______?
— We get together to enjoy the moon and eat moon cakes.

options.text: why do you like the Chinese New Year best
how do you celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival
how Chinese people celebrate the Chinese New Year
what Chinese people do on the Mid-Autumn Festival

questions.reason: 赏月、吃月饼是中秋活动，应用 what … do on the Mid-Autumn Festival，且从句保持陈述语序。

questions.stem:
— Could you please tell me_________?
— Next Thursday morning.

options.text: when we visited the Capital Museum
when did we visit the Capital Museum
when we will visit the Capital Museum
when will we visit the Capital Museum

questions.reason: Next Thursday morning 表未来时间，填 when we will visit；不用过去式或 will we 的倒装。

questions.stem: Could you please tell me________? I want to borrow some books.
questions.reason: 想借书，需要问图书馆现在在哪里，从句为 where the library is；where is … 为直接问句语序。

questions.stem:
— Do you know ________ ?

options.text: why I have to do it

questions.reason: 建议合理安排时间，回应如何完成读书报告，用 how I can do it；B、D均有倒装问题。

questions.stem:
— Do you know _______________?
— Sure. On May 15th.

options.text: how China's Tianwen-1 probe landed on Mars
when China's Tianwen-1 probe landed on Mars

questions.reason: On May 15th 是日期，问 when … landed；where 问地点，how 问方式，均不对应。

questions.reason: 过去课堂上学生被问问题，the students 作受事，填 were asked，与 Did you notice 的过去语境一致。

questions.stem:
— What did Daniel say to you?
— He asked me __________.

options.text: how did I get to Hubei Museum
why I liked hot- dry noodles so much
how many bridges are there in Wuhan
what will I study in Wuhan University

questions.reason: asked 为过去，从句用过去时且陈述语序；B why I liked 符合，其他选项保留了问句倒装。

where we can get some food quickly

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “it” refer to?

context.text: The spaceship and three astronauts of the Shenzhou XIII task were successfully sent to the Tiangong space station on Oct. 16, 2021. The members of China’s Shenzhou XIII task, Wang Yaping, Zhai Zhigang and Ye Guangfu, gave a lecture to students around the world on Dec. 9, 2021. The lecture meant the beginning of the Heavenly Palace Class(天宫课堂). This was the first try of it. During the lecture, the astronauts showed the space station, their scientific experiments and some interesting physical phenomena(现象) to the students. The second Heavenly Palace Class was on Mar. 23, 2022. Certainly, they were special, interesting and fantastic lectures all over the world. Wang Yaping also took part in the Shenzhou X task that lasted nearly 15 days on Jun. 11, 2013. During that task, she carried out the nation’s first space-based lecture to Chinese students on Jun. 20, 2013. The activity made China, following the United States, the second country to have held a space-based class for students. In the future, the Heavenly Palace Class will encourage more young people to study science and technology and learn something more about the space.

questions.stem: How many suggestions does the writer give in the passage to be carbon neutral?

context.text: Recently, the term “carbon neutral(碳中和)” has been used frequently at some important meetings in many countries. Many countries have put forward the goal of striving(奋斗目标) to be carbon neutral. China is expected to be carbon neutral by 2060. So, as middle school students, what can we do to protect the environment and live a low carbon life? Here are some suggestions for you. Travel in a green way. Now more Chinese people have cars of their own. It has brought us a lot of benefits but has created some serious problems as well. So we’d better do more walking, cycling and less driving. By doing so, we can save energy and reduce pollution. Cut down white pollution. We should reduce the pollution of plastic bags. When you go to the supermarket, bring your own shopping bags. Save water. Lack of water resources will affect the ecological environment(生态环境). So please turn off the tap after using it. Sort the rubbish. Doing garbage classification(垃圾分类) in a right way can turn waste into wealth. Plant more trees. Planting more trees means cutting down and reducing the carbon footprint(碳足迹) and spreading of greenhouse gases. For example, the trees planted in China are playing an important role. A report published in Nature shows that CO2 absorption(吸收) in two new forest areas in China is more than we thought. The two areas are located in China’s southwestern and northeastern provinces. They make up over 35 percent of China’s carbon sinks(碳汇). The main natural carbon sinks are trees and other plants. Use both sides of the paper. The paper production process uses a lot of trees. Now is the time that we should take up our responsibility to protect our environment from being polluted. Let’s join our hands and take actions immediately.

questions.stem: What does modern research show?

options.text: Exercise is good for our health.
Animals are different from men in laughing.

context.text: There’s an old saying, “Laughter is the best medicine.” And modern research certainly shows that laughing is good for you. When you have a good laugh, you exercise your tummy （肚子）muscles, strengthen your heart and balance your body chemistry. However, these are the results of having a laugh, not the explanations of why we do it. Until recently, scientists believed that laughter was a human behavior only. They argued that people find jokes funny because we can put ourselves in another person’s shoes, and that animals can’t do that. Yet people don’t all have the same sense of humor. Sometimes there isn’t an actual joke, or we may not have heard it; but we laugh because the people around us are laughing. The timing（时机）and loudness of this kind of laughter are also shared: we begin laughing together, and we go on mirroring one another until the laughter goes away. They quit laughing. Many pet owners believe that animals have a sense of humor too. For example, pet dogs often run away with shoes and then stop, inviting their owners to run after them. Dogs even seem to smile when their owners join in the game. As the game continues, our pets make noises that are like laughter. You can compare this behavior to the laughter of a baby, who frequently throws a toy down, waits for the adult to pick it up and throws it down again. Perhaps laughter is just a sign that we are having fun. Fun, like laughter, is best when we share it with friends.
